title: Three Kinds of Maintenance

purpose.en: Explains the three kinds of maintenance work (Preventive, Breakdown, Improvement) so you know which one a job belongs to.
purpose.id: Menjelaskan tiga jenis pekerjaan maintenance (Preventive, Breakdown, Improvement) supaya Anda tahu sebuah pekerjaan masuk jenis yang mana.

keywords: maintenance, perawatan mesin, preventive, breakdown, corrective, improvement, perbaikan, pm, jenis maintenance, en 13306

steps.en: Preventive: work done on a schedule before the machine fails, for example changing hydraulic oil every set number of running hours or cleaning rollers every week.
steps.id: Preventive: pekerjaan sesuai jadwal sebelum mesin rusak, misalnya ganti oli hidrolik tiap sekian jam jalan atau bersihkan roller tiap minggu.

steps.en: Preventive work can be triggered by the calendar, by machine usage (running hours or impressions) or by the machine condition.
steps.id: Pekerjaan preventive bisa dipicu oleh kalender, oleh pemakaian mesin (jam jalan atau impresi) atau oleh kondisi mesin.

steps.en: Breakdown: work done after a machine stops or fails, for example a jammed feeder or a leaking hydraulic pump. The aim is to get the machine running again and record the cause.
steps.id: Breakdown: pekerjaan setelah mesin berhenti atau rusak, misalnya feeder macet atau pompa hidrolik bocor. Tujuannya mesin jalan lagi dan penyebabnya tercatat.

steps.en: Improvement: a change to the machine or to the way it is maintained so it becomes more reliable, for example a longer-lasting part or a better service interval. Results are compared before and after.
steps.id: Improvement: perubahan pada mesin atau cara merawatnya supaya lebih andal, misalnya part yang lebih awet atau interval servis yang lebih tepat. Hasilnya dibandingkan sebelum dan sesudah.

title: Rules for Recording Maintenance Data

purpose.en: Four recording habits that keep maintenance reports correct: pick from lists, record downtime and labour separately, never delete history, keep reports apart from jobs.
purpose.id: Empat kebiasaan pencatatan agar laporan maintenance benar: pilih dari daftar, catat downtime dan jam kerja terpisah, jangan hapus riwayat, pisahkan laporan dari pekerjaan.

keywords: aturan pencatatan, downtime, jam kerja teknisi, riwayat, order perawatan, request, laporan masalah, catat maintenance

steps.en: Pick locations and cost centres from the list instead of typing them. Free text cannot be added up in reports.
steps.id: Pilih lokasi dan cost center dari daftar, jangan diketik. Teks bebas tidak bisa dijumlahkan di laporan.

steps.en: Record downtime (how long the machine stood still) and technician hours (how long people worked) as two different numbers. A 240-minute stop is not 240 minutes of work.
steps.id: Catat downtime (berapa lama mesin diam) dan jam teknisi (berapa lama orang bekerja) sebagai dua angka berbeda. Berhenti 240 menit bukan berarti 240 menit kerja.

steps.en: Do not delete a record. Change its status and keep the row, because the history is used to work out reliability.
steps.id: Jangan hapus catatan. Ubah statusnya dan biarkan barisnya, karena riwayat dipakai untuk menghitung keandalan.

steps.en: A problem report (Request) is kept apart from the job (Maintenance Order), so rejected or duplicate reports do not pollute the job data.
steps.id: Laporan masalah (Request) dipisah dari pekerjaannya (Maintenance Order), sehingga laporan yang ditolak atau dobel tidak mengotori data pekerjaan.

title: Operator Daily Checks (TPM)

purpose.en: Explains why operators look after their own machine every day (Total Productive Maintenance) and what a daily check usually covers.
purpose.id: Menjelaskan mengapa operator merawat mesinnya sendiri setiap hari (Total Productive Maintenance) dan apa yang biasanya dicek tiap hari.

keywords: tpm, total productive maintenance, autonomous maintenance, cek harian, daily checklist, operator, kebersihan mesin, inspeksi harian

steps.en: The operator is the first to notice a change in sound, vibration or leaks, so TPM asks operators to do the basic care of their own machine.
steps.id: Operator adalah orang pertama yang menyadari perubahan suara, getaran atau kebocoran, jadi TPM meminta operator melakukan perawatan dasar mesinnya sendiri.

steps.en: A daily check usually covers: clean the machine area, look for oil or water leaks, listen for unusual noise or vibration, check lubrication and fluid levels, check guards and the emergency stop.
steps.id: Cek harian biasanya meliputi: bersihkan area mesin, cari kebocoran oli atau air, dengar suara atau getaran tidak biasa, cek pelumasan dan level cairan, cek pengaman dan tombol darurat.

steps.en: Report anything abnormal at once, before it turns into a breakdown.
steps.id: Laporkan segera hal yang tidak normal, sebelum menjadi kerusakan.

title: Maintenance Indicators (MTBF, MTTR, PM Compliance, OEE)

purpose.en: Defines the four numbers used to judge maintenance: how often machines fail, how fast they recover, how well the schedule is followed and how effective the machine is.
purpose.id: Menjelaskan empat angka untuk menilai maintenance: seberapa sering mesin rusak, seberapa cepat pulih, seberapa disiplin jadwal dijalankan dan seberapa efektif mesin.

keywords: mtbf, mttr, pm compliance, oee, indikator maintenance, keandalan mesin, availability, ketersediaan mesin, kinerja maintenance

steps.en: MTBF (mean time between failures) is the period hours minus breakdown downtime hours, divided by the number of breakdowns. A higher number is better.
steps.id: MTBF (rata-rata jarak antar kerusakan) adalah jam periode dikurangi jam downtime breakdown, dibagi jumlah breakdown. Makin besar makin baik.

steps.en: MTTR (mean time to repair) is the total breakdown downtime hours divided by the number of breakdowns. A lower number is better.
steps.id: MTTR (rata-rata waktu perbaikan) adalah total jam downtime breakdown dibagi jumlah breakdown. Makin kecil makin baik.

steps.en: PM compliance is the number of preventive jobs finished on time divided by the number that were due.
steps.id: PM compliance adalah jumlah pekerjaan preventive yang selesai tepat waktu dibagi jumlah yang jatuh tempo.

steps.en: OEE combines availability, performance and quality into one figure for how effectively a machine is used.
steps.id: OEE menggabungkan ketersediaan, kecepatan dan mutu menjadi satu angka tentang seberapa efektif mesin dipakai.

steps.en: MTBF and MTTR are only valid when every breakdown is recorded as downtime of kind BREAKDOWN with a start and an end time.
steps.id: MTBF dan MTTR hanya valid bila setiap breakdown dicatat sebagai downtime jenis BREAKDOWN dengan waktu mulai dan selesai.

title: What to Watch on Printing and Packaging Machines

purpose.en: Lists the points commonly watched on offset, lamination and finishing machines. Intervals and limits always follow the machine maker's manual.
purpose.id: Daftar titik yang lazim dipantau pada mesin offset, laminasi dan finishing. Interval dan batas normal selalu mengikuti manual pabrikan mesin.

keywords: roller, silinder impresi, hidrolik, kalibrasi suhu, doctor blade, deep cleaning, mesin cetak, offset, laminasi, finishing, titik pantau

steps.en: Rollers: surface condition and alignment.
steps.id: Roller: kondisi permukaan dan kelurusan.

steps.en: Impression cylinders: wear and cleanliness.
steps.id: Silinder impresi: keausan dan kebersihan.

steps.en: Hydraulic system: leaks, pressure and oil level.
steps.id: Sistem hidrolik: kebocoran, tekanan dan level oli.

steps.en: Temperature calibration on heating, coating and lamination units.
steps.id: Kalibrasi suhu pada unit pemanas, coating dan laminasi.

steps.en: Doctor blades: sharpness and wear.
steps.id: Doctor blade: ketajaman dan keausan.

steps.en: Deep cleaning on a schedule, not only when the machine looks dirty.
steps.id: Deep cleaning terjadwal, bukan hanya saat mesin terlihat kotor.

title: Asset Maintenance Profile

purpose.en: Holds what each asset needs to be maintained: what to check, which spare parts, which SOP and work instructions. Open it to prepare an asset or to see what is still missing.
purpose.id: Berisi kebutuhan perawatan tiap aset: apa yang dicek, spare part, SOP dan instruksi kerja. Buka untuk menyiapkan aset atau melihat apa yang masih kurang.

keywords: profil aset, asset maintenance profile, watch point, spare part, dokumen, sop, wi, kendaraan, ac, mesin, kelengkapan

steps.en: Open Asset Maintenance Profile. Use the boxes (Production machine, Support equipment, Vehicle, Facility) or the filters, and search by code or name.
steps.id: Buka Asset Maintenance Profile. Pakai kotak (Production machine, Support equipment, Vehicle, Facility) atau filter, lalu cari berdasarkan kode atau nama.

steps.en: To bring in the machines click Add machines from Master Machine. Machines already there are not duplicated.
steps.id: Untuk memasukkan mesin klik Add machines from Master Machine. Mesin yang sudah ada tidak digandakan.

steps.en: For a vehicle or facility click + New Record, type code, name, class, criticality, meter and location, then Save.
steps.id: Untuk kendaraan atau fasilitas klik + New Record, ketik kode, nama, kelas, kritikalitas, meter dan lokasi, lalu Save.

steps.en: Double-click an asset to open its profile. The tabs below the form are Watch Points, Spare Parts and Documents. History lists who changed what.
steps.id: Klik dua kali sebuah aset untuk membuka profilnya. Tab di bawah form adalah Watch Points, Spare Parts dan Documents. History menampilkan siapa mengubah apa.

steps.en: On Watch Points type what to check and press + Watch Point, or copy the list of another asset with Copy. Fill the normal limit from the manufacturer manual, or leave it empty.
steps.id: Di Watch Points ketik hal yang dicek lalu tekan + Watch Point, atau salin daftar aset lain dengan Copy. Isi batas normal dari manual pabrikan, atau biarkan kosong.

steps.en: On Spare Parts pick a material and press + Spare Part. On Documents pick an SOP or work instruction and press + Link.
steps.id: Di Spare Parts pilih material lalu tekan + Spare Part. Di Documents pilih SOP atau instruksi kerja lalu tekan + Link.

steps.en: Only the head of maintenance and administrators can change a profile. Others can read it.
steps.id: Hanya kepala maintenance dan administrator yang bisa mengubah profil. Yang lain hanya membaca.

fields.label: Asset Code
fields.en: Short code of the asset. Typed for vehicles and facilities. For a machine it comes from Master Machine and is locked.
fields.id: Kode singkat aset. Diketik untuk kendaraan dan fasilitas. Untuk mesin berasal dari Master Machine dan terkunci.

fields.label: Asset Name
fields.en: Name of the asset. Typed, or taken from Master Machine for a machine.
fields.id: Nama aset. Diketik, atau diambil dari Master Machine untuk mesin.

fields.label: Class
fields.en: Production machine, Support equipment, Vehicle or Facility. Decides the meter and which indicators apply.
fields.id: Production machine, Support equipment, Vehicle atau Facility. Menentukan meter dan indikator yang berlaku.

fields.label: Criticality
fields.en: A stops the line, B slows it, C has a replacement. For a machine it is read from Master Machine.
fields.id: A menghentikan lini, B memperlambat, C punya pengganti. Untuk mesin dibaca dari Master Machine.

fields.label: Meter
fields.en: No meter, Run hours, Impressions or Odometer (km). Used later by meter-based plans.
fields.id: No meter, Run hours, Impressions atau Odometer (km). Dipakai nanti oleh plan berbasis meter.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Where the asset is, for example Dispatch or Office.
fields.id: Lokasi aset, misalnya Dispatch atau Office.

fields.label: Fixed Asset (Finance, optional)
fields.en: Links the asset to its record in the Finance fixed asset register.
fields.id: Menautkan aset ke catatannya di register aset tetap Finance.

fields.label: Complete
fields.en: How many of Watch Points, Spare Parts, Documents and Meter are filled, for example 2 / 4. Calculated, never typed.
fields.id: Berapa dari Watch Points, Spare Parts, Documents dan Meter yang terisi, misalnya 2 / 4. Dihitung, tidak diketik.

fields.label: What to check
fields.en: Short text of the check, for example Oil level, no leak.
fields.id: Teks singkat cek, misalnya Level oli, tidak bocor.

fields.label: Normal min / Normal max
fields.en: Optional limits with a unit. Without them the check is never judged by the system.
fields.id: Batas opsional dengan satuan. Tanpa itu cek tidak pernah dinilai sistem.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.en: Every shift, Daily, Weekly or Monthly.
fields.id: Every shift, Daily, Weekly atau Monthly.

fields.label: Checked by
fields.en: Operator or Technician.
fields.id: Operator atau Technician.

fields.label: Suggested min stock
fields.en: Minimum stock Maintenance suggests for the part.
fields.id: Stok minimum yang disarankan Maintenance untuk part.

fields.label: Critical
fields.en: Marks a part whose absence stops the asset.
fields.id: Menandai part yang bila habis aset berhenti.

title: SOP and Work Instructions

purpose.en: Holds the SOP and work instructions of Maintenance, each with a number, a revision and a status. Open it to read a document, edit a draft or approve it.
purpose.id: Berisi SOP dan instruksi kerja Maintenance, masing-masing dengan nomor, revisi dan status. Buka untuk membaca dokumen, mengubah draf atau menyetujuinya.

keywords: sop, wi, instruksi kerja, prosedur, dokumen maintenance, revisi, approve, draf

steps.en: Open SOP and Work Instructions. Use the boxes (Draft, Approved, SOP, Work Instruction) or filters, and search by number or title.
steps.id: Buka SOP and Work Instructions. Pakai kotak (Draft, Approved, SOP, Work Instruction) atau filter, lalu cari berdasarkan nomor atau judul.

steps.en: Click the arrow of a row to read its content without opening it. Double-click a row to open the document.
steps.id: Klik panah sebuah baris untuk membaca isinya tanpa membukanya. Klik dua kali baris untuk membuka dokumen.

steps.en: For a new document click + New Record, type number, kind, set and title, then Save. Add the lines in the Content tab with + Line.
steps.id: Untuk dokumen baru klik + New Record, ketik nomor, jenis, set dan judul, lalu Save. Tambah baris isi di tab Content dengan + Line.

steps.en: Edit the text, adding the limits and intervals from the manufacturer manual, then Save.
steps.id: Ubah teksnya, tambahkan batas dan interval dari manual pabrikan, lalu Save.

steps.en: Press Approve when the document is correct. An approved document is locked.
steps.id: Tekan Approve bila dokumen sudah benar. Dokumen yang disetujui terkunci.

steps.en: To change an approved document press Back to Draft. This starts a new revision and the document is a draft again.
steps.id: Untuk mengubah dokumen yang disetujui tekan Back to Draft. Ini memulai revisi baru dan dokumen kembali menjadi draf.

steps.en: The Assets tab lists the assets that use the document. Link a document to an asset in Asset Maintenance Profile.
steps.id: Tab Assets menampilkan aset yang memakai dokumen. Hubungkan dokumen ke aset di Asset Maintenance Profile.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Number such as WI-MNT-OFF-02. SOP-MNT or WI-MNT, then the set code, then a two digit sequence.
fields.id: Nomor seperti WI-MNT-OFF-02. SOP-MNT atau WI-MNT, lalu kode set, lalu urutan dua digit.

fields.label: Kind
fields.en: SOP, Work Instruction, Manual, Drawing, Vendor contact or Other.
fields.id: SOP, Work Instruction, Manual, Drawing, Vendor contact atau Other.

fields.label: Set
fields.en: Group of assets the document is written for, for example OFF for offset presses.
fields.id: Kelompok aset yang dituju dokumen, misalnya OFF untuk mesin offset.

fields.label: Revision
fields.en: Two digit revision. Starts at 00 and goes up each time an approved document goes back to draft.
fields.id: Revisi dua digit. Mulai dari 00 dan naik tiap kali dokumen yang disetujui kembali menjadi draf.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Draft can be edited. Approved is locked.
fields.id: Draft bisa diubah. Approved terkunci.

fields.label: Section
fields.en: Heading of a line, for example Purpose, Responsibilities, Safety or Steps.
fields.id: Judul sebuah baris, misalnya Purpose, Responsibilities, Safety atau Steps.

fields.label: Text
fields.en: One sentence or one step of the document.
fields.id: Satu kalimat atau satu langkah dokumen.

title: Maintenance Codes

purpose.en: The catalog of Component, Problem, Cause and Action codes used by watch points, spare parts and orders, so reports can add failures up. Open it to add or change a code.
purpose.id: Katalog kode Component, Problem, Cause dan Action yang dipakai watch point, spare part dan order, supaya laporan bisa menjumlahkan kerusakan. Buka untuk menambah atau mengubah kode.

keywords: kode maintenance, component, problem, cause, action, katalog kode, kerusakan

steps.en: Open Maintenance Codes. The rows are typed directly in the cells, as in other small lists.
steps.id: Buka Maintenance Codes. Barisnya diketik langsung di sel, seperti daftar kecil lainnya.

steps.en: Pick the Type first, then type a short upper-case Code and its Name in English.
steps.id: Pilih Type lebih dulu, lalu ketik Code huruf besar yang singkat dan Name dalam bahasa Inggris.

steps.en: Leave Applies To empty when the code fits every asset, or type a group such as Printing.
steps.id: Biarkan Applies To kosong bila kode cocok untuk semua aset, atau ketik kelompok seperti Printing.

steps.en: Untick Active instead of deleting a code that is no longer used, so old records keep their meaning.
steps.id: Hilangkan centang Active, jangan hapus kode yang tidak dipakai lagi, supaya catatan lama tetap bermakna.

steps.en: Click Save to store all changed rows.
steps.id: Klik Save untuk menyimpan semua baris yang berubah.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: Component, Problem, Cause or Action.
fields.id: Component, Problem, Cause atau Action.

fields.label: Code
fields.en: Short upper-case code, unique inside its type.
fields.id: Kode huruf besar singkat, unik di dalam jenisnya.

fields.label: Name
fields.en: English name. Other languages come through the dictionary.
fields.id: Nama dalam bahasa Inggris. Bahasa lain lewat kamus.

fields.label: Applies To (blank = all)
fields.en: Optional group of assets the code is meant for.
fields.id: Kelompok aset yang dituju kode, opsional.

fields.label: Sort
fields.en: Order in the dropdowns.
fields.id: Urutan di dropdown.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Only active codes appear in the dropdowns.
fields.id: Hanya kode aktif yang muncul di dropdown.

title: Asset Readiness

purpose.en: Shows how complete the maintenance profile of every asset is, so the head of maintenance can chase the missing data. Open it to see which assets still need work.
purpose.id: Menampilkan seberapa lengkap profil perawatan tiap aset, supaya kepala maintenance bisa mengejar data yang kurang. Buka untuk melihat aset mana yang masih perlu dikerjakan.

keywords: kesiapan aset, asset readiness, kelengkapan profil, watch point, spare part, dokumen, meter

steps.en: Open Asset Readiness. The boxes are Empty, Incomplete and Complete.
steps.id: Buka Asset Readiness. Kotaknya adalah Empty, Incomplete dan Complete.

steps.en: Group by Class, Level or Criticality to see where most of the gaps are.
steps.id: Kelompokkan menurut Class, Level atau Criticality untuk melihat di mana kekurangan terbanyak.

steps.en: Click a row to open the profile of that asset and fill what is missing.
steps.id: Klik sebuah baris untuk membuka profil aset itu dan mengisi yang kurang.

steps.en: Use Export to hand the list to whoever fills the data.
steps.id: Pakai Export untuk menyerahkan daftar ke orang yang mengisi data.

fields.label: Asset
fields.en: Code and name of the asset.
fields.id: Kode dan nama aset.

fields.label: Class
fields.en: Production machine, Support equipment, Vehicle or Facility.
fields.id: Production machine, Support equipment, Vehicle atau Facility.

fields.label: Criticality
fields.en: A, B or C. Blank when it has not been set.
fields.id: A, B atau C. Kosong bila belum ditetapkan.

fields.label: Watch Points
fields.en: Number of active watch points.
fields.id: Jumlah watch point aktif.

fields.label: Spare Parts
fields.en: Number of active spare parts.
fields.id: Jumlah spare part aktif.

fields.label: Documents
fields.en: Number of linked SOP, work instructions and other documents.
fields.id: Jumlah SOP, instruksi kerja dan dokumen lain yang terhubung.

fields.label: Meter
fields.en: The meter type of the asset.
fields.id: Jenis meter aset.

fields.label: Complete %
fields.en: Share of the four items that are filled.
fields.id: Bagian dari empat hal yang sudah terisi.

fields.label: Level
fields.en: Empty (nothing filled), Incomplete, or Complete.
fields.id: Empty (belum ada yang terisi), Incomplete, atau Complete.

title: Technical Plan: Maintenance Module

purpose.en: Technical plan of the Maintenance module: scope, database, phases and principles. This is a plan for review, not a description of screens that exist today.
purpose.id: Rencana teknis modul Maintenance: ruang lingkup, database, fase dan prinsip. Ini rencana untuk di-review, bukan penjelasan layar yang sudah ada saat ini.

keywords: rencana teknis maintenance, technical plan, tm2mnt, ddtmnt, fase bangun, modul maintenance, arsitektur

steps.en: Maintenance has its own database tm2mnt (dummy copy ddtmnt) and its own module code MAINT. It is separate from Production.
steps.id: Maintenance punya database sendiri tm2mnt (salinan dummy ddtmnt) dan kode modul MAINT sendiri. Terpisah dari Production.

steps.en: Menu has four groups: Preventive Maintenance, Breakdown Maintenance, Improvement and Master Data, plus a Report group.
steps.id: Menu terdiri dari empat kelompok: Preventive Maintenance, Breakdown Maintenance, Improvement dan Master Data, ditambah kelompok Report.

steps.en: Phase 1 Master Data: machine profile with Watch Points, Spare Parts and Documents, the code catalog, and a readiness grid.
steps.id: Fase 1 Master Data: profil aset dengan Watch Points, Spare Parts dan Documents, katalog kode, dan grid kesiapan.

steps.en: Phase 2 Preventive: plans, PM calendar, meter readings, Daily Check and the machine-blocked slot on the Scheduling Board.
steps.id: Fase 2 Preventive: plan, kalender PM, pembacaan meter, Daily Check dan slot mesin terblokir di Scheduling Board.

steps.en: Phase 3 Breakdown: requests, maintenance orders, spare part issue and purchase request, and the reliability report.
steps.id: Fase 3 Breakdown: request, order perawatan, pengeluaran spare part dan permintaan pembelian, serta laporan keandalan.

steps.en: Phase 4 Improvement: proposals, recurrence suggestion, review before and after, and master changes approved by a person.
steps.id: Fase 4 Improvement: usulan, saran kerusakan berulang, review sebelum dan sesudah, dan perubahan master yang disetujui orang.

steps.en: Master data is changed only by users. The system changes transactions and only proposes changes to master data.
steps.id: Master data hanya diubah oleh user. Sistem mengubah transaksi dan hanya mengusulkan perubahan pada master data.

steps.en: Every value the module reads (thresholds, rates) has an input screen in Settings, Constants. Nothing is fixed in code.
steps.id: Setiap nilai yang dibaca modul (ambang, tarif) punya layar input di Settings, Constants. Tidak ada yang dikunci di kode.

fields.label: Database
fields.en: tm2mnt for live, ddtmnt for mockup. Connection name equals the database name.
fields.id: tm2mnt untuk live, ddtmnt untuk mockup. Nama koneksi sama dengan nama database.

fields.label: Module code
fields.en: MAINT. Groups MAINT_TECH (technician) and MAINT_HEAD (head of maintenance).
fields.id: MAINT. Grup MAINT_TECH (teknisi) dan MAINT_HEAD (kepala maintenance).

fields.label: Tables
fields.en: Prefix mnt_. Primary key id_<entity> BIGINT, audit columns, no foreign key across databases.
fields.id: Prefix mnt_. Primary key id_<entitas> BIGINT, kolom audit, tanpa foreign key lintas database.

fields.label: Language
fields.en: Database and formulas are in English. Indonesian only on screen and print through the dictionary.
fields.id: Database dan rumus dalam bahasa Inggris. Bahasa Indonesia hanya di layar dan cetak lewat kamus.

title: Technical Plan: Maintenance Menu

purpose.en: The planned menu of the Maintenance module: four groups plus Report, and which screen belongs to which phase.
purpose.id: Menu Maintenance yang direncanakan: empat kelompok ditambah Report, dan layar mana masuk fase mana.

keywords: menu maintenance, kelompok menu, preventive, breakdown, improvement, master data, report, layer menu

steps.en: The module has four groups: Preventive Maintenance, Breakdown Maintenance, Improvement and Master Data. A small Report group sits below them.
steps.id: Modul punya empat kelompok: Preventive Maintenance, Breakdown Maintenance, Improvement dan Master Data. Kelompok kecil Report ada di bawahnya.

steps.en: Preventive Maintenance Order (PMO) and Breakdown Maintenance Order (BMO) are two menu doors to one Maintenance Order design and one table. Each door has its own number prefix.
steps.id: Preventive Maintenance Order (PMO) dan Breakdown Maintenance Order (BMO) adalah dua pintu menu ke satu desain Maintenance Order dan satu tabel. Tiap pintu punya prefiks nomor sendiri.

steps.en: The menu shows only screens that already exist. A screen appears the day its phase is delivered.
steps.id: Menu hanya menampilkan layar yang sudah ada. Sebuah layar muncul pada hari fasenya selesai.

steps.en: Access follows module MAINT. Everyone who may enter Production can report a problem. Decisions need the approve right.
steps.id: Akses mengikuti modul MAINT. Siapa pun yang boleh masuk Production boleh melapor masalah. Keputusan butuh hak approve.

fields.label: Preventive Maintenance
fields.en: Preventive Plan, PM Calendar, Preventive Maintenance Order (PMO), Daily Check, Meter Readings. Delivered in Phase 2.
fields.id: Preventive Plan, PM Calendar, Preventive Maintenance Order (PMO), Daily Check, Meter Readings. Dikirim di Fase 2.

fields.label: Breakdown Maintenance
fields.en: Maintenance Request, Breakdown Maintenance Order (BMO), My Work for technicians. Delivered in Phase 3.
fields.id: Maintenance Request, Breakdown Maintenance Order (BMO), My Work untuk teknisi. Dikirim di Fase 3.

fields.label: Improvement
fields.en: Improvement Proposal and Improvement Review. Improvement orders (IMO) are opened from the proposal. Delivered in Phase 4.
fields.id: Improvement Proposal dan Improvement Review. Order improvement (IMO) dibuka dari usulannya. Dikirim di Fase 4.

fields.label: Master Data
fields.en: Asset Maintenance Profile, Maintenance Codes, and a link to Master Mesin. Delivered in Phase 1.
fields.id: Asset Maintenance Profile, Maintenance Codes, dan tautan ke Master Mesin. Dikirim di Fase 1.

fields.label: Report
fields.en: Maintenance Order Report, Machine Reliability, PM Compliance. Delivered with the phase whose data they read.
fields.id: Maintenance Order Report, Machine Reliability, PM Compliance. Dikirim bersama fase yang datanya mereka baca.

title: Technical Plan: Assets, Not Only Machines

purpose.en: Maintenance looks after assets: production machines, support equipment, vehicles and facilities such as air conditioners. This explains how the classes differ.
purpose.id: Maintenance merawat aset: mesin produksi, alat penunjang, kendaraan dan fasilitas seperti AC. Ini menjelaskan perbedaan antar kelas.

keywords: aset, kendaraan, ac, fasilitas, genset, kelas aset, odometer, stnk, kir, aset tetap, asset maintenance

steps.en: The scope is Asset, decided by the user on 2026-10-08. Every Maintenance document points to an asset in mnt_asset, never directly to a machine.
steps.id: Cakupannya Aset, diputuskan user pada 2026-10-08. Setiap dokumen Maintenance menunjuk ke aset di mnt_asset, tidak langsung ke mesin.

steps.en: Machines come from Master Machine with the button Add machines from Master Machine. Only code, name and class follow the master. Criticality, meter and notes belong to Maintenance.
steps.id: Mesin datang dari Master Machine lewat tombol Add machines from Master Machine. Hanya kode, nama dan kelas yang mengikuti master. Kritikalitas, meter dan catatan milik Maintenance.

steps.en: Vehicles and facilities are typed in Asset Maintenance Profile. An asset can be linked to its Finance fixed asset record for the cost side.
steps.id: Kendaraan dan fasilitas diketik di Asset Maintenance Profile. Sebuah aset bisa ditautkan ke catatan aset tetap Finance untuk sisi biayanya.

steps.en: The same screens, preventive and breakdown orders (PMO and BMO), and reports work for every class. What differs is the meter, the documents and the indicators.
steps.id: Layar yang sama, order preventive dan breakdown (PMO dan BMO), dan laporan berlaku untuk semua kelas. Yang berbeda adalah meter, dokumen dan indikator.

fields.label: Production machine
fields.en: Printing and finishing machines. Meter run hours or impressions. OEE applies.
fields.id: Mesin cetak dan finishing. Meter jam jalan atau impresi. OEE berlaku.

fields.label: Support equipment
fields.en: Compressor, forklift, heater. Meter run hours. Legal inspection dates apply to the compressor and the forklift. No OEE.
fields.id: Kompresor, forklift, pemanas. Meter jam jalan. Tanggal inspeksi wajib berlaku untuk kompresor dan forklift. Tanpa OEE.

fields.label: Vehicle
fields.en: Trucks and cars. Meter odometer in km. Documents with an expiry date (registration, inspection, tax, insurance) become fixed-date inspection orders. No OEE.
fields.id: Truk dan mobil. Meter odometer dalam km. Dokumen berjatuh tempo (STNK, KIR, pajak, asuransi) menjadi order inspeksi tanggal tetap. Tanpa OEE.

fields.label: Facility
fields.en: Air conditioners, generator, pumps, electrical panels, buildings. Often no meter, time-based schedules such as filter cleaning. No OEE.
fields.id: AC, genset, pompa, panel listrik, bangunan. Sering tanpa meter, jadwal berbasis waktu seperti bersih filter. Tanpa OEE.

fields.label: Indicators
fields.en: Availability, MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance and cost work for all classes. OEE only for production machines.
fields.id: Availability, MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance dan biaya berlaku untuk semua kelas. OEE hanya untuk mesin produksi.

title: Technical Plan: Features and Their Functions

purpose.en: What each planned Maintenance feature is for, who uses it, and which phase delivers it.
purpose.id: Fungsi tiap fitur Maintenance yang direncanakan, siapa pemakainya, dan fase mana yang mengirimnya.

keywords: fitur maintenance, fungsi fitur, watch point, daily check, pm calendar, meter, request, order perawatan, improvement, laporan

steps.en: Features are grouped like the menu. Master Data features describe the machine, Preventive features keep machines healthy, Breakdown features fix failures, Improvement features stop repeats.
steps.id: Fitur dikelompokkan seperti menu. Fitur Master Data menjelaskan mesin, fitur Preventive menjaga mesin tetap sehat, fitur Breakdown memperbaiki kerusakan, fitur Improvement mencegah pengulangan.

steps.en: Each feature has one job and hands its result to the next one. The Data Flow and Work Flow topics show how they connect.
steps.id: Setiap fitur punya satu tugas dan menyerahkan hasilnya ke fitur berikutnya. Topik Data Flow dan Work Flow menunjukkan hubungannya.

fields.label: Asset Maintenance Profile
fields.en: Phase 1. One place to describe what a machine needs: checks, parts and documents. Used by every later feature.
fields.id: Fase 1. Satu tempat untuk menjelaskan kebutuhan mesin: cek, part dan dokumen. Dipakai semua fitur berikutnya.

fields.label: Watch Points
fields.en: Phase 1. The list of things to check on a machine, with how, normal limit, frequency and who checks.
fields.id: Fase 1. Daftar hal yang dicek pada mesin, dengan cara, batas normal, frekuensi dan siapa yang mengecek.

fields.label: Spare Parts per asset
fields.en: Phase 1. Tells which parts a machine needs and when stock is too low, so a missing part is known before a breakdown.
fields.id: Fase 1. Menunjukkan part yang dibutuhkan mesin dan kapan stok terlalu rendah, sehingga part yang kurang diketahui sebelum kerusakan.

fields.label: Maintenance Codes
fields.en: Phase 1. One catalog of component, problem, cause and action codes, so reports can be added up.
fields.id: Fase 1. Satu katalog kode komponen, masalah, penyebab dan tindakan, sehingga laporan bisa dijumlahkan.

fields.label: Asset Readiness
fields.en: Phase 1. A grid that shows which machines still have an incomplete profile, so data entry can be chased.
fields.id: Fase 1. Grid yang menunjukkan mesin mana yang profilnya belum lengkap, sehingga pengisian data bisa dikejar.

fields.label: Preventive Plan
fields.en: Phase 2. Defines when a machine needs a scheduled job: by calendar or by meter, with checklist and standard parts.
fields.id: Fase 2. Menentukan kapan mesin butuh pekerjaan terjadwal: menurut kalender atau meter, dengan checklist dan part standar.

fields.label: PM Calendar
fields.en: Phase 2. Shows scheduled, overdue and blocked days so the head of maintenance can see the month at a glance.
fields.id: Fase 2. Menampilkan hari terjadwal, terlambat dan terblokir sehingga kepala maintenance melihat satu bulan sekaligus.

fields.label: Meter Readings
fields.en: Phase 2. Records machine running hours or impressions so meter-based plans fall due at the right time.
fields.id: Fase 2. Mencatat jam jalan atau impresi mesin sehingga plan berbasis meter jatuh tempo pada waktu yang tepat.

fields.label: Daily Check
fields.en: Phase 2. Lets the operator check the machine every shift and report anything abnormal before it breaks.
fields.id: Fase 2. Membuat operator mengecek mesin tiap shift dan melaporkan hal tidak normal sebelum rusak.

fields.label: Maintenance Request
fields.en: Phase 3. A short report of a problem that anyone can make. It keeps rejected or duplicate reports out of the job data.
fields.id: Fase 3. Laporan singkat masalah yang bisa dibuat siapa pun. Menjaga laporan ditolak atau dobel keluar dari data pekerjaan.

fields.label: Maintenance Order (PMO, BMO, IMO)
fields.en: Phase 3. The authorised job with schedule, technician, checklist, parts, hours, downtime and cost. PMO for preventive, BMO for breakdown, IMO for improvement.
fields.id: Fase 3. Pekerjaan resmi dengan jadwal, teknisi, checklist, part, jam, downtime dan biaya. PMO untuk preventive, BMO untuk breakdown, IMO untuk improvement.

fields.label: My Work
fields.en: Phase 3. A technician view of the jobs assigned to him or her today, made for a phone.
fields.id: Fase 3. Tampilan teknisi untuk pekerjaan yang ditugaskan hari ini, dibuat untuk HP.

fields.label: Improvement Proposal
fields.en: Phase 4. Turns a repeated problem into a reasoned proposal with evidence, cost and saving.
fields.id: Fase 4. Mengubah masalah berulang menjadi usulan beralasan dengan bukti, biaya dan penghematan.

fields.label: Improvement Review
fields.en: Phase 4. Compares downtime and cost before and after, so the user learns whether the improvement worked.
fields.id: Fase 4. Membandingkan downtime dan biaya sebelum dan sesudah, sehingga user tahu apakah improvement berhasil.

fields.label: Reports
fields.en: Maintenance Order Report, Machine Reliability (MTBF, MTTR, Availability) and PM Compliance. Each is delivered with the phase whose data it reads.
fields.id: Maintenance Order Report, Machine Reliability (MTBF, MTTR, Availability) dan PM Compliance. Masing-masing dikirim bersama fase yang datanya dibaca.

title: Technical Plan: Roles and User Journey

purpose.en: Who does what in Maintenance: what each role opens, sees, clicks and gets.
purpose.id: Siapa melakukan apa di Maintenance: apa yang dibuka, dilihat, diklik dan didapat tiap peran.

keywords: peran maintenance, user journey, operator, teknisi, kepala maintenance, ppic, manajemen, hak akses, grup

steps.en: Operator: opens Daily Check at the start of the shift, marks each point, and reports a problem as a Request. Gets a request number and, for a stopped critical machine, a maintenance order at once.
steps.id: Operator: membuka Daily Check di awal shift, menandai tiap titik, dan melapor masalah sebagai Request. Mendapat nomor request dan, untuk mesin kritis berhenti, order perawatan langsung.

steps.en: Head of maintenance: opens the Request list sorted by priority and age, then presses Accept or Reject. Sets schedule and technician on Confirm, and presses Close when a job is Done.
steps.id: Kepala maintenance: membuka daftar Request menurut prioritas dan umur, lalu menekan Accept atau Reject. Mengatur jadwal dan teknisi saat Confirm, dan menekan Close saat pekerjaan Done.

steps.en: Technician: opens My Work, presses Start, fills checklist, parts, hours and codes, then Done. Gets the machine back to ready and the downtime closed.
steps.id: Teknisi: membuka My Work, menekan Start, mengisi checklist, part, jam dan kode, lalu Done. Mesin kembali ready dan downtime tertutup.

steps.en: Planner in production: sees blocked slots on the Scheduling Board and can only suggest moving them. The head of maintenance confirms.
steps.id: Perencana di produksi: melihat slot terblokir di Scheduling Board dan hanya bisa mengusulkan menggesernya. Kepala maintenance yang mengonfirmasi.

steps.en: Management: opens the reports, filters by machine and month, and decides to repair, improve or replace.
steps.id: Manajemen: membuka laporan, menyaring menurut mesin dan bulan, lalu memutuskan memperbaiki, memperbaiki lebih jauh atau mengganti.

steps.en: System: every morning it turns due plans into Draft maintenance orders and checks for repeated failures. It only creates drafts and suggestions.
steps.id: Sistem: tiap pagi mengubah plan jatuh tempo menjadi order perawatan Draft dan memeriksa kerusakan berulang. Hanya membuat draft dan saran.

fields.label: MAINT_TECH
fields.en: Technician group. Can view master data and work on assigned jobs. Cannot change master data or decide.
fields.id: Grup teknisi. Bisa melihat master data dan mengerjakan pekerjaan yang ditugaskan. Tidak bisa mengubah master data atau memutuskan.

fields.label: MAINT_HEAD
fields.en: Head of maintenance group. Can change master data and has the approve right for Accept, Confirm and Close.
fields.id: Grup kepala maintenance. Bisa mengubah master data dan punya hak approve untuk Accept, Confirm dan Close.

fields.label: Production staff
fields.en: Anyone who may enter Production can file a Request and fill Daily Check. They cannot decide.
fields.id: Siapa pun yang boleh masuk Production bisa membuat Request dan mengisi Daily Check. Mereka tidak bisa memutuskan.

fields.label: Director
fields.en: Also approves an improvement above the cost limit set in Constants.
fields.id: Juga menyetujui improvement di atas batas biaya yang diatur di Constants.

fields.label: Administrator
fields.en: Can do everything, including changing master data.
fields.id: Bisa melakukan semuanya, termasuk mengubah master data.

title: Technical Plan: Work Flow by Type

purpose.en: Step by step work flow of the three kinds of maintenance, with the status of the documents at each step.
purpose.id: Alur kerja langkah demi langkah dari tiga jenis maintenance, dengan status dokumen pada tiap langkah.

keywords: work flow maintenance, alur kerja, status order perawatan, request, draft confirmed in progress waiting part done closed, prioritas p1 p2 p3 p4

steps.en: Preventive (PMO): Plan, Generate, Confirm, Start, Done, Close. A scheduled command turns due plans into Draft orders. The head sets schedule and technician and presses Confirm.
steps.id: Preventive (PMO): Plan, Generate, Confirm, Start, Done, Close. Perintah terjadwal mengubah plan jatuh tempo menjadi order Draft. Kepala mengatur jadwal dan teknisi lalu menekan Confirm.

steps.en: Preventive: the technician presses Start, fills the checklist, uses parts and records hours, then Done. The head checks cost and findings and presses Close. The next due date is recalculated.
steps.id: Preventive: teknisi menekan Start, mengisi checklist, memakai part dan mencatat jam, lalu Done. Kepala memeriksa biaya dan temuan lalu menekan Close. Jatuh tempo berikutnya dihitung ulang.

steps.en: Breakdown (BMO): Request, Accept, Start, Done, Close. Anyone files a Request. The head presses Accept, which creates a Confirmed order, or Reject with a reason.
steps.id: Breakdown (BMO): Request, Accept, Start, Done, Close. Siapa pun membuat Request. Kepala menekan Accept sehingga order Confirmed dibuat, atau Reject dengan alasan.

steps.en: Breakdown: priority P1 on a machine that stopped goes straight to a maintenance order. The technician can press Hold when a part is missing and Resume when it arrives.
steps.id: Breakdown: prioritas P1 pada mesin berhenti langsung menjadi order perawatan. Teknisi bisa menekan Hold saat part kurang dan Resume saat part tiba.

steps.en: Breakdown: Done closes the downtime and returns the machine to ready. The head presses Close after checking cost, problem, cause and action codes.
steps.id: Breakdown: Done menutup downtime dan mengembalikan mesin ke ready. Kepala menekan Close setelah memeriksa biaya serta kode masalah, penyebab dan tindakan.

steps.en: Improvement (IMO): Proposal, Confirm, Implement, Done, Review, Apply. The head confirms, an order of type IMPROVEMENT is created, and after the review a person applies the changes.
steps.id: Improvement (IMO): Proposal, Confirm, Implement, Done, Review, Apply. Kepala mengonfirmasi, order jenis IMPROVEMENT dibuat, dan setelah review orang yang menerapkan perubahan.

fields.label: Draft
fields.en: A document being prepared. It can be edited and deleted.
fields.id: Dokumen yang sedang disiapkan. Bisa diubah dan dihapus.

fields.label: Confirmed
fields.en: Decided and scheduled. Inside Confirmed the work status runs Scheduled, In Progress, Waiting Part and Done.
fields.id: Sudah diputuskan dan dijadwalkan. Di dalam Confirmed, status kerja berjalan Scheduled, In Progress, Waiting Part dan Done.

fields.label: Closed
fields.en: Verified by the head. Costs are final and the history is kept.
fields.id: Sudah diverifikasi kepala. Biaya final dan riwayat disimpan.

fields.label: Cancelled
fields.en: A Confirmed document that was called off, with a reason.
fields.id: Dokumen Confirmed yang dibatalkan, dengan alasan.

fields.label: Request statuses
fields.en: Open, Accepted (a maintenance order was created) and Rejected (with a reason).
fields.id: Open, Accepted (order perawatan dibuat) dan Rejected (dengan alasan).

fields.label: P1 Emergency
fields.en: A critical machine has stopped. Becomes a maintenance order at once.
fields.id: Mesin kritis berhenti. Langsung menjadi order perawatan.

fields.label: P2 High
fields.en: To be handled within 24 hours.
fields.id: Ditangani dalam 24 jam.

fields.label: P3 Normal
fields.en: To be handled within a week.
fields.id: Ditangani dalam seminggu.

fields.label: P4 Low
fields.en: To be handled when time allows, for example improvements.
fields.id: Ditangani bila ada waktu, misalnya improvement.

title: Technical Plan: Dashboard and KPI

purpose.en: Where the Maintenance indicators appear, what they look like, how the target lights work, and where OEE fits. The mockup is a proposal waiting for approval.
purpose.id: Di mana indikator Maintenance tampil, bentuknya, cara lampu target bekerja, dan posisi OEE. Mockup ini usulan yang menunggu persetujuan.

keywords: kpi maintenance, dashboard maintenance, oee, mtbf, mttr, availability, pm compliance, target, grafik, lampu target

steps.en: The Maintenance Dashboard is the first screen of the module. Row one has six indicators with targets. Row two has action numbers for today with no target.
steps.id: Maintenance Dashboard adalah layar pertama modul. Baris pertama berisi enam indikator dengan target. Baris kedua berisi angka tindakan hari ini tanpa target.

steps.en: Each indicator card has a coloured edge: green when the target is met, yellow when close, red when missed. Targets are typed by the user in Settings, Constants.
steps.id: Setiap kartu indikator punya tepi berwarna: hijau bila target tercapai, kuning bila dekat, merah bila meleset. Target diketik user di Settings, Constants.

steps.en: Clicking a card opens the Maintenance KPI report for the same period and machine. It is one report with many columns and graphs, not several small reports.
steps.id: Klik kartu membuka laporan Maintenance KPI untuk periode dan mesin yang sama. Satu laporan kaya kolom dan grafik, bukan beberapa laporan kecil.

steps.en: Graphs: trend of OEE and availability, OEE loss from 100 percent planned time, MTBF and MTTR trend, downtime by kind, failures by component, top machines by downtime.
steps.id: Grafik: tren OEE dan availability, rugi OEE dari 100 persen waktu terencana, tren MTBF dan MTTR, downtime menurut jenis, kerusakan per komponen, mesin dengan downtime terbanyak.

steps.en: OEE belongs to Production. Maintenance contributes the downtime that drives Availability and only displays OEE, read only, from the Production engine.
steps.id: OEE milik Production. Maintenance menyumbang downtime yang menggerakkan Availability dan hanya menampilkan OEE, hanya dibaca, dari engine Production.

steps.en: OEE applies to production machines only. Vehicles and other assets show reliability, downtime and cost, without OEE.
steps.id: OEE hanya berlaku untuk mesin produksi. Kendaraan dan aset lain menampilkan keandalan, downtime dan biaya, tanpa OEE.

fields.label: Indicators with targets
fields.en: Availability, MTBF, MTTR, PM Compliance, Planned work, Backlog.
fields.id: Availability, MTBF, MTTR, PM Compliance, Planned work, Backlog.

fields.label: Action numbers
fields.en: Machines down now, open requests, overdue PM, orders in progress, orders waiting for part, critical parts below minimum.
fields.id: Mesin sedang down, request terbuka, PM terlambat, order berjalan, order menunggu part, part kritis di bawah minimum.

fields.label: MNT_TARGET_AVAILABILITY
fields.en: Proposal 97 percent. Yellow when within a small margin below the target.
fields.id: Usulan 97 persen. Kuning bila sedikit di bawah target.

fields.label: MNT_TARGET_MTBF_HOURS
fields.en: Proposal 120 hours. Higher is better.
fields.id: Usulan 120 jam. Makin tinggi makin baik.

fields.label: MNT_TARGET_MTTR_HOURS
fields.en: Proposal 4 hours. Lower is better.
fields.id: Usulan 4 jam. Makin rendah makin baik.

fields.label: MNT_TARGET_PM_COMPLIANCE
fields.en: Proposal 90 percent, a common industry target.
fields.id: Usulan 90 persen, target umum di industri.

fields.label: MNT_TARGET_PLANNED_WORK
fields.en: Proposal 85 percent, a common industry target.
fields.id: Usulan 85 persen, target umum di industri.

fields.label: Backlog range
fields.en: Proposal 3 to 5 weeks is healthy. Below 3 means idle technicians, above 5 means a pile-up.
fields.id: Usulan 3 sampai 5 minggu sehat. Di bawah 3 teknisi menganggur, di atas 5 pekerjaan menumpuk.

fields.label: OEE target
fields.en: Already typed per machine in the machine master (target OEE percent). The dashboard compares with it.
fields.id: Sudah diketik per mesin di master mesin (target OEE persen). Dashboard membandingkan dengan itu.

title: Technical Plan: Maintenance Data Flow

purpose.en: Shows how a report, a plan or a repeated failure becomes a maintenance order, and what each maintenance order writes to other modules.
purpose.id: Menunjukkan bagaimana laporan, plan atau kerusakan berulang menjadi order perawatan, dan apa yang ditulis tiap order perawatan ke modul lain.

keywords: alur data maintenance, data flow, request, order perawatan, daily check, improvement, downtime, spare part

steps.en: An operator Daily Check with a NOT_OK result opens a Maintenance Request, not a maintenance order, so the head of maintenance judges it.
steps.id: Daily Check operator dengan hasil NOT_OK membuka Maintenance Request, bukan order perawatan, sehingga kepala maintenance yang menilai.

steps.en: Anyone can also report a problem as a Maintenance Request. The head accepts it, which creates a maintenance order, or rejects it with a reason.
steps.id: Siapa pun juga bisa melapor masalah sebagai Maintenance Request. Kepala menerimanya sehingga order perawatan dibuat, atau menolak dengan alasan.

steps.en: A request about a machine that stopped, on a critical machine, becomes a maintenance order at once without waiting for approval.
steps.id: Request tentang mesin berhenti pada mesin kritis langsung menjadi order perawatan tanpa menunggu persetujuan.

steps.en: Every morning a scheduled command turns due preventive plans into draft maintenance orders. The head sets the schedule and confirms them.
steps.id: Tiap pagi perintah terjadwal mengubah plan preventive yang jatuh tempo menjadi draft order perawatan. Kepala mengatur jadwal dan mengonfirmasinya.

steps.en: Starting a maintenance order that needs the machine stopped opens a downtime row and sets the machine status. Done closes the downtime and sets the status back to ready.
steps.id: Memulai order perawatan yang butuh mesin berhenti membuka baris downtime dan mengatur status mesin. Done menutup downtime dan mengembalikan status ke ready.

steps.en: Spare parts of a maintenance order are issued from Inventory. A missing part creates a purchase request and the maintenance order waits for the part.
steps.id: Spare part sebuah order perawatan dikeluarkan dari Inventory. Part yang kurang membuat permintaan pembelian dan order perawatan menunggu part.

steps.en: A repeated failure on the same component raises an Improvement suggestion. An accepted proposal becomes a maintenance order of type IMPROVEMENT.
steps.id: Kerusakan berulang pada komponen yang sama memunculkan saran Improvement. Usulan yang diterima menjadi order perawatan jenis IMPROVEMENT.

steps.en: Some days after an improvement is done, the review compares downtime and cost before and after. A person decides which master changes to apply.
steps.id: Beberapa hari setelah improvement selesai, review membandingkan downtime dan biaya sebelum dan sesudah. Orang yang memutuskan perubahan master mana yang diterapkan.

steps.en: Master data feeds the rest: Daily Check reads watch points, maintenance orders read spare parts and codes, and reports read all of them.
steps.id: Master data memberi makan fitur lain: Daily Check membaca watch point, order perawatan membaca spare part dan kode, dan laporan membaca semuanya.

fields.label: Writes to Master
fields.en: Machine downtime rows and machine status, only through the maintenance order service.
fields.id: Baris downtime mesin dan status mesin, hanya lewat service order perawatan.

fields.label: Writes to Inventory
fields.en: Stock issue document for spare parts, referenced to the maintenance order.
fields.id: Dokumen pengeluaran stok untuk spare part, merujuk ke order perawatan.

fields.label: Writes to Procurement
fields.en: Purchase request for missing parts, marked as coming from Maintenance.
fields.id: Permintaan pembelian untuk part yang kurang, ditandai berasal dari Maintenance.

fields.label: Reads from Production
fields.en: Production output for meters, and breakdown events of maintenance orders.
fields.id: Output produksi untuk meter, dan kejadian breakdown pada order perawatan.

fields.label: Reads from Scheduling
fields.en: Confirmed preventive maintenance orders block the machine on the Scheduling Board.
fields.id: Maintenance order preventive yang Confirmed memblokir mesin di Scheduling Board.

fields.label: Master data readers
fields.en: Daily Check reads mnt_watch_point. Maintenance orders read mnt_asset_part and mnt_code. Reports read everything. Stock is read from Inventory.
fields.id: Daily Check membaca mnt_watch_point. Maintenance order membaca mnt_asset_part dan mnt_code. Laporan membaca semuanya. Stok dibaca dari Inventory.

title: Technical Plan: Maintenance Tables

purpose.en: Lists the tables planned for Maintenance in tm2mnt, phase by phase, and how they relate to other databases.
purpose.id: Daftar tabel yang direncanakan untuk Maintenance di tm2mnt, per fase, dan hubungannya dengan database lain.

keywords: tabel maintenance, mnt_code, mnt_watch_point, mnt_asset_part, mnt_order, mnt_request, skema, tm2mnt, kolom

steps.en: All tables live in tm2mnt. Relations to machines, materials, employees and production records point to other databases and are checked by Laravel, never by foreign keys.
steps.id: Semua tabel ada di tm2mnt. Relasi ke mesin, material, pegawai dan data produksi mengarah ke database lain dan dicek oleh Laravel, bukan foreign key.

steps.en: Machine downtime and machine status stay in the Master database (prod_machine_downtime, prod_machine). Maintenance orders write to them through one service, so there is no second downtime table.
steps.id: Downtime dan status mesin tetap di database Master (prod_machine_downtime, prod_machine). Maintenance order menulis ke sana lewat satu service, jadi tidak ada tabel downtime kedua.

steps.en: A request or maintenance order about a production breakdown keeps breakdown_event_id, a logical link to prd_breakdown_event in Production.
steps.id: Request atau order perawatan tentang kerusakan produksi menyimpan breakdown_event_id, tautan logis ke prd_breakdown_event di Production.

steps.en: Phase 1 tables are listed first. Tables of later phases are listed with the phase that creates them.
steps.id: Tabel Fase 1 dicantumkan lebih dulu. Tabel fase berikutnya dicantumkan bersama fase yang membuatnya.

fields.label: mnt_code
fields.en: Phase 1. Code catalog: type (COMPONENT, PROBLEM, CAUSE, ACTION), code, name, sort order, activate.
fields.id: Fase 1. Katalog kode: jenis (COMPONENT, PROBLEM, CAUSE, ACTION), kode, nama, urutan, activate.

fields.label: mnt_asset
fields.en: Phase 1. One row per maintained asset: code, name, class (production machine, support equipment, vehicle, facility), logical link to the machine master or to a Finance fixed asset, criticality, meter type, location.
fields.id: Fase 1. Satu baris per aset yang dirawat: kode, nama, kelas (mesin produksi, alat penunjang, kendaraan, fasilitas), tautan logis ke master mesin atau aset tetap Finance, kritikalitas, jenis meter, lokasi.

fields.label: mnt_watch_point
fields.en: Phase 1. What to check on an asset: component code, check text, method, normal min and max, unit, frequency, checker role, sort order.
fields.id: Fase 1. Hal yang dicek pada aset: kode komponen, teks cek, cara, batas normal min dan max, satuan, frekuensi, peran pemeriksa, urutan.

fields.label: mnt_asset_part
fields.en: Phase 1. Spare part of an asset: material, component code, quantity per use, suggested minimum stock, expected life in days, critical flag.
fields.id: Fase 1. Spare part milik aset: material, kode komponen, qty per pemakaian, saran stok minimum, umur pakai dalam hari, penanda kritis.

fields.label: mnt_plan, mnt_plan_task, mnt_plan_part
fields.en: Phase 2. Preventive plan with trigger (time or meter), fixed or floating schedule, task checklist and standard parts.
fields.id: Fase 2. Plan preventive dengan pemicu (waktu atau meter), jadwal fixed atau floating, checklist tugas dan part standar.

fields.label: mnt_document, mnt_document_line, mnt_asset_document
fields.en: Phase 1. SOP and WI text with number, revision and status (DRAFT or APPROVED), its lines, and the link that assigns each document to assets. Manual, drawing and vendor contact use the same table with a file location.
fields.id: Fase 1. Teks SOP dan WI dengan nomor, revisi dan status (DRAFT atau APPROVED), baris isinya, dan tautan yang menetapkan tiap dokumen ke aset. Manual, gambar dan kontak vendor memakai tabel yang sama dengan lokasi file.

fields.label: mnt_meter_reading
fields.en: Phase 2. Machine meter readings, typed by a user or accumulated from production output.
fields.id: Fase 2. Pembacaan meter mesin, diketik user atau diakumulasi dari output produksi.

fields.label: mnt_daily_check, mnt_daily_check_line
fields.en: Phase 2. One check sheet per machine per shift, and one result line per watch point (OK, NOT_OK, NA, measured value).
fields.id: Fase 2. Satu lembar cek per mesin per shift, dan satu baris hasil per watch point (OK, NOT_OK, NA, nilai ukur).

fields.label: mnt_order, mnt_order_task, mnt_order_part, mnt_order_labor
fields.en: Phase 2. Maintenance Order with five order types: PREVENTIVE and INSPECTION (prefix PMO), BREAKDOWN and CORRECTIVE (prefix BMO), IMPROVEMENT (prefix IMO). Tasks, parts and technician hours.
fields.id: Fase 2. Maintenance Order dengan lima jenis: PREVENTIVE dan INSPECTION (prefiks PMO), BREAKDOWN dan CORRECTIVE (prefiks BMO), IMPROVEMENT (prefiks IMO). Tugas, part dan jam teknisi.

fields.label: mnt_request
fields.en: Phase 2 table, Phase 3 screen. Problem report with priority and status. Daily Check creates it for every Not OK point.
fields.id: Tabel Fase 2, layar Fase 3. Laporan masalah dengan prioritas dan status. Daily Check membuatnya untuk setiap titik Not OK.

fields.label: mnt_log
fields.en: Phase 3. History of status changes and actions per document.
fields.id: Fase 3. Riwayat perubahan status dan tindakan per dokumen.

fields.label: mnt_improvement, mnt_improvement_change
fields.en: Phase 4. Improvement proposal with before and after figures, and proposed master changes that only a person can approve.
fields.id: Fase 4. Usulan improvement dengan angka sebelum dan sesudah, dan usulan perubahan master yang hanya bisa disetujui orang.

title: Technical Plan: Maintenance Rules and Formulas

purpose.en: Rules, indicator formulas and the settings that Maintenance will read. Values marked as proposal are starting values that the user may change.
purpose.id: Aturan, rumus indikator dan pengaturan yang akan dibaca Maintenance. Nilai berlabel usulan adalah nilai awal yang boleh diubah user.

keywords: rumus maintenance, mtbf, mttr, pm compliance, constants, ambang, aturan, kelengkapan profil, recurrence

steps.en: Profile completeness counts five things that are filled: an active watch point, an active plan, a spare part, a document, and a meter type. It is calculated, not stored.
steps.id: Kelengkapan profil menghitung lima hal yang terisi: watch point aktif, plan aktif, spare part, dokumen, dan jenis meter. Dihitung, tidak disimpan.

steps.en: A watch point without a normal limit is never judged by the system. Limits come from the manufacturer manual and are typed by the head of maintenance.
steps.id: Watch point tanpa batas normal tidak pernah dinilai sistem. Batas berasal dari manual pabrikan dan diketik oleh kepala maintenance.

steps.en: Spare parts are picked from the material lookup. Cleaning up old spare parts that still sit in the category Others is a separate task for the user.
steps.id: Spare part dipilih dari lookup material. Merapikan spare part lama yang masih di kategori Others adalah tugas terpisah untuk user.

steps.en: Technicians can view the master data. Only the head of maintenance and administrators can change it.
steps.id: Teknisi bisa melihat master data. Hanya kepala maintenance dan administrator yang bisa mengubahnya.

steps.en: Apply to master is never automatic. The head ticks and approves each proposed change one by one, and each is logged.
steps.id: Apply to master tidak pernah otomatis. Kepala mencentang dan menyetujui tiap usulan satu per satu, dan masing-masing dicatat.

steps.en: Document numbers follow one pattern: prefix, year and month (yymm), and a four digit sequence, for example PMO-2610-0001. Each prefix has its own sequence that restarts every month.
steps.id: Nomor dokumen mengikuti satu pola: prefiks, tahun dan bulan (yymm), dan urutan empat digit, misalnya PMO-2610-0001. Tiap prefiks punya urutan sendiri yang mulai lagi tiap bulan.

fields.label: MTBF
fields.en: (Period hours minus breakdown downtime hours) divided by the number of breakdowns, from the downtime log. Same calculation as the Production engine.
fields.id: (Jam periode dikurangi jam downtime breakdown) dibagi jumlah breakdown, dari log downtime. Perhitungannya sama dengan engine Production.

fields.label: MTTR
fields.en: Total breakdown downtime hours divided by the number of breakdowns, from the downtime log.
fields.id: Total jam downtime breakdown dibagi jumlah breakdown, dari log downtime.

fields.label: Availability
fields.en: In OEE: (planned minutes minus unplanned downtime) divided by planned minutes. Inherent availability in the reliability report: MTBF divided by MTBF plus MTTR.
fields.id: Dalam OEE: (menit terencana dikurangi downtime tak terencana) dibagi menit terencana. Availability inheren di laporan keandalan: MTBF dibagi MTBF ditambah MTTR.

fields.label: PM Compliance
fields.en: Preventive and inspection maintenance orders done on time divided by those due in the period.
fields.id: Maintenance order preventive dan inspeksi yang selesai tepat waktu dibagi yang jatuh tempo dalam periode.

fields.label: MNT_RECURRENCE_COUNT
fields.en: Proposal 3. Same failure on the same component that triggers an Improvement suggestion.
fields.id: Usulan 3. Kerusakan sama pada komponen yang sama yang memicu saran Improvement.

fields.label: MNT_RECURRENCE_DAYS
fields.en: Proposal 90. Window in days for counting repeated failures.
fields.id: Usulan 90. Jendela hari untuk menghitung kerusakan berulang.

fields.label: MNT_IMPROVEMENT_REVIEW_DAYS
fields.en: Proposal 60. Days after Done when the improvement review is due.
fields.id: Usulan 60. Hari setelah Done saat review improvement jatuh tempo.

fields.label: MNT_IMPROVEMENT_DIRECTOR_LIMIT
fields.en: Proposal 10,000,000 IDR. Above this estimated cost the director also approves.
fields.id: Usulan 10.000.000 IDR. Di atas estimasi biaya ini direksi ikut menyetujui.

fields.label: PMO
fields.en: Preventive Maintenance Order. Order types PREVENTIVE and INSPECTION. Example PMO-2610-0001.
fields.id: Preventive Maintenance Order. Jenis order PREVENTIVE dan INSPECTION. Contoh PMO-2610-0001.

fields.label: BMO
fields.en: Breakdown Maintenance Order. Order types BREAKDOWN and CORRECTIVE. Example BMO-2610-0001.
fields.id: Breakdown Maintenance Order. Jenis order BREAKDOWN dan CORRECTIVE. Contoh BMO-2610-0001.

fields.label: IMO
fields.en: Improvement Maintenance Order. Order type IMPROVEMENT, opened from an Improvement Proposal. Example IMO-2610-0001.
fields.id: Improvement Maintenance Order. Jenis order IMPROVEMENT, dibuka dari Improvement Proposal. Contoh IMO-2610-0001.

fields.label: MR, IMP, DC
fields.en: Maintenance Request MR, Improvement Proposal IMP, Daily Check DC. Same pattern as the orders.
fields.id: Maintenance Request MR, Improvement Proposal IMP, Daily Check DC. Pola sama dengan order.

fields.label: OEE
fields.en: Availability times Performance times Quality, calculated by Production. If a factor cannot be calculated, OEE shows not calculated, never 0 percent.
fields.id: Availability kali Performance kali Quality, dihitung Production. Bila satu faktor tidak bisa dihitung, OEE tampil belum dihitung, bukan 0 persen.

fields.label: Performance
fields.en: Good output divided by run hours times target speed per hour, at most 100 percent.
fields.id: Output bagus dibagi jam jalan kali target kecepatan per jam, paling tinggi 100 persen.

fields.label: Quality
fields.en: Good output divided by good output plus spoilage plus waste.
fields.id: Output bagus dibagi output bagus ditambah spoilage ditambah waste.

fields.label: Backlog
fields.en: Estimated hours of open orders divided by technician hours available per week, shown in weeks.
fields.id: Estimasi jam order yang masih terbuka dibagi jam teknisi tersedia per minggu, tampil dalam minggu.

fields.label: Planned work
fields.en: Orders that are not BREAKDOWN divided by all orders in the period.
fields.id: Order yang bukan BREAKDOWN dibagi semua order dalam periode.

title: Technical Plan: Maintenance Terms

purpose.en: The terms used in Maintenance, with one short meaning each, so screens, reports and Help use the same words.
purpose.id: Istilah yang dipakai di Maintenance, masing-masing dengan satu arti singkat, supaya layar, laporan dan Help memakai kata yang sama.

keywords: istilah maintenance, glosarium, oee, mtbf, mttr, pmo, bmo, imo, loto, kritikalitas, downtime

steps.en: Every screen label stays in English. Indonesian meanings appear through the dictionary.
steps.id: Semua label layar tetap bahasa Inggris. Arti dalam bahasa Indonesia muncul lewat kamus.

steps.en: The same word always means the same thing: for example Order means a Maintenance Order and never a production work order.
steps.id: Kata yang sama selalu berarti hal yang sama: misalnya Order berarti Maintenance Order dan tidak pernah work order produksi.

fields.label: OEE
fields.en: Overall equipment effectiveness: Availability times Performance times Quality. Calculated by Production.
fields.id: Efektivitas peralatan keseluruhan: Availability kali Performance kali Quality. Dihitung Production.

fields.label: Availability
fields.en: Share of planned time the machine was able to run.
fields.id: Bagian waktu terencana saat mesin mampu berjalan.

fields.label: Performance
fields.en: How fast the machine ran compared with its target speed.
fields.id: Seberapa cepat mesin berjalan dibanding kecepatan targetnya.

fields.label: Quality
fields.en: Share of output that was good.
fields.id: Bagian output yang bagus.

fields.label: MTBF
fields.en: Mean time between failures: average run time between two breakdowns.
fields.id: Rata-rata waktu jalan di antara dua breakdown.

fields.label: MTTR
fields.en: Mean time to repair: average downtime of one breakdown.
fields.id: Rata-rata downtime satu breakdown.

fields.label: PM Compliance
fields.en: Share of preventive orders done on time.
fields.id: Bagian order preventive yang selesai tepat waktu.

fields.label: Planned work
fields.en: Share of orders that were planned, not breakdowns.
fields.id: Bagian order yang terencana, bukan breakdown.

fields.label: Backlog
fields.en: Open work expressed in weeks of technician time.
fields.id: Pekerjaan terbuka dinyatakan dalam minggu waktu teknisi.

fields.label: Downtime
fields.en: Time a machine is stopped. Planned (maintenance, setup) or unplanned (breakdown, waiting).
fields.id: Waktu mesin berhenti. Terencana (maintenance, setup) atau tak terencana (breakdown, menunggu).

fields.label: Criticality A, B, C
fields.en: How badly production suffers when the machine stops: A stops the line, C has a replacement.
fields.id: Seberapa parah produksi terganggu bila mesin berhenti: A menghentikan lini, C punya pengganti.

fields.label: Watch Point
fields.en: One thing to check on a machine, with how, limit, frequency and who checks.
fields.id: Satu hal yang dicek pada mesin, dengan cara, batas, frekuensi dan pemeriksa.

fields.label: PMO
fields.en: Preventive Maintenance Order: scheduled work, types PREVENTIVE and INSPECTION.
fields.id: Preventive Maintenance Order: pekerjaan terjadwal, jenis PREVENTIVE dan INSPECTION.

fields.label: BMO
fields.en: Breakdown Maintenance Order: repair work, types BREAKDOWN and CORRECTIVE.
fields.id: Breakdown Maintenance Order: pekerjaan perbaikan, jenis BREAKDOWN dan CORRECTIVE.

fields.label: IMO
fields.en: Improvement Maintenance Order: work that makes an asset more reliable, type IMPROVEMENT.
fields.id: Improvement Maintenance Order: pekerjaan yang membuat aset lebih andal, jenis IMPROVEMENT.

fields.label: SOP
fields.en: Standard operating procedure: who does what, how often, and how it is recorded.
fields.id: Prosedur operasi standar: siapa mengerjakan apa, seberapa sering, dan bagaimana dicatat.

fields.label: WI
fields.en: Work instruction: the step by step way to do one task.
fields.id: Instruksi kerja: cara langkah demi langkah mengerjakan satu tugas.

fields.label: LOTO
fields.en: Lock-out tag-out: isolating and locking the energy supply before work inside a machine.
fields.id: Lock-out tag-out: memutus dan mengunci sumber energi sebelum bekerja di dalam mesin.

title: Technical Plan: Asset Maintenance Profile

purpose.en: The Master Data form approved on the mockup: one profile per machine holding what to check, which spare parts it needs, and its documents.
purpose.id: Form Master Data yang disetujui di mockup: satu profil per mesin berisi apa yang dicek, spare part yang dibutuhkan, dan dokumennya.

keywords: machine maintenance profile, profil aset, watch points, spare parts, documents, kelengkapan profil, copy from machine

steps.en: Open Asset Maintenance Profile and pick a machine. The form has tabs Profile, Watch Points, Spare Parts, Documents and History. The PM Plans tab appears when Phase 2 is delivered.
steps.id: Buka Asset Maintenance Profile dan pilih mesin. Form punya tab Profile, Watch Points, Spare Parts, Documents dan History. Tab PM Plans muncul saat Fase 2 selesai.

steps.en: For a machine from Master Machine, code, name, class and criticality come from the master and are locked. Other assets (vehicle, air conditioner) are typed here.
steps.id: Untuk mesin dari Master Machine, kode, nama, kelas dan kritikalitas berasal dari master dan terkunci. Aset lain (kendaraan, AC) diketik di sini.

steps.en: On Watch Points add what must be checked on this machine. Pick the component from the code catalog, describe the check and the method, and set the frequency and who checks.
steps.id: Di Watch Points tambahkan hal yang harus dicek pada mesin ini. Pilih komponen dari katalog kode, tulis cek dan caranya, lalu atur frekuensi dan siapa yang mengecek.

steps.en: Type the normal limit from the manufacturer manual, or leave it empty. The system never fills a limit itself.
steps.id: Ketik batas normal dari manual pabrikan, atau biarkan kosong. Sistem tidak pernah mengisi batas sendiri.

steps.en: Copy from machine copies the watch points of another machine as a starting point. You then edit them. It never overwrites rows that already exist.
steps.id: Copy from machine menyalin watch point mesin lain sebagai titik awal. Setelah itu Anda mengubahnya. Tidak pernah menimpa baris yang sudah ada.

steps.en: On Spare Parts add the parts this asset needs. Stock from Inventory is shown when Phase 3 connects it, so Phase 1 holds the part list and the suggested minimum.
steps.id: Di Spare Parts tambahkan part yang dibutuhkan aset ini. Stok dari Inventory tampil saat Fase 3 menyambungkannya, jadi Fase 1 berisi daftar part dan saran minimum.

steps.en: Save stores the changes. Undo drops changes that are not saved yet. History lists who changed what and when.
steps.id: Save menyimpan perubahan. Undo membuang perubahan yang belum disimpan. History menampilkan siapa mengubah apa dan kapan.

fields.label: Profile completeness
fields.en: Shows how many of five items are filled, for example 3 / 5. It is calculated from the data, never typed.
fields.id: Menunjukkan berapa dari lima hal yang terisi, misalnya 3 / 5. Dihitung dari data, tidak diketik.

fields.label: Component
fields.en: Pick from Maintenance Codes. There is no component tree: a component is only a code.
fields.id: Pilih dari Maintenance Codes. Tidak ada pohon komponen: komponen hanya berupa kode.

fields.label: What to check
fields.en: Short text of the check, for example oil level, no leak. Free text typed by the user.
fields.id: Teks singkat cek, misalnya level oli, tidak bocor. Teks bebas yang diketik user.

fields.label: Normal limit
fields.en: Optional minimum and maximum with a unit. Without it the check is never judged by the system.
fields.id: Minimum dan maksimum opsional dengan satuan. Tanpa itu cek tidak pernah dinilai oleh sistem.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.en: Every shift, Daily, Weekly or Monthly.
fields.id: Setiap shift, Harian, Mingguan atau Bulanan.

fields.label: Checked by
fields.en: Operator or Technician. Operator checks feed Daily Check.
fields.id: Operator atau Technician. Cek oleh operator menjadi sumber Daily Check.

fields.label: Suggested min stock
fields.en: Minimum stock that Maintenance suggests for this part. Procurement still decides what to buy.
fields.id: Stok minimum yang disarankan Maintenance untuk part ini. Procurement tetap yang memutuskan pembelian.

fields.label: Expected life
fields.en: How long the part usually lasts, in days. Used to judge wear later.
fields.id: Berapa lama part biasanya bertahan, dalam hari. Dipakai menilai keausan nanti.

fields.label: Critical
fields.en: Marks a part whose absence stops the machine. Critical parts below minimum show on the Dashboard.
fields.id: Menandai part yang bila habis mesin berhenti. Part kritis di bawah minimum tampil di Dashboard.

title: Technical Plan: SOP and Work Instructions per Machine

purpose.en: How an SOP and four work instructions (WI) are prepared for every machine, numbered, approved and shown in the Asset Maintenance Profile. All texts are drafts until approved.
purpose.id: Cara SOP dan empat instruksi kerja (WI) disusun untuk setiap mesin, diberi nomor, disetujui dan tampil di Asset Maintenance Profile. Semua teks berstatus draf sampai disetujui.

keywords: sop, wi, instruksi kerja, prosedur, dokumen mesin, lock out tag out, daily check, perawatan mingguan, perawatan bulanan, breakdown

steps.en: Machines are grouped into sets by machine type. Each set has one SOP and four work instructions: daily check, weekly care, monthly care and breakdown first response.
steps.id: Mesin dikelompokkan menjadi set menurut jenis mesin. Tiap set punya satu SOP dan empat instruksi kerja: cek harian, perawatan mingguan, perawatan bulanan dan respons awal breakdown.

steps.en: Numbers follow one pattern: SOP-MNT and WI-MNT, then the set code, then a two digit sequence, for example WI-MNT-OFF-01 for the daily check of an offset press.
steps.id: Nomor mengikuti satu pola: SOP-MNT dan WI-MNT, lalu kode set, lalu urutan dua digit, misalnya WI-MNT-OFF-01 untuk cek harian mesin offset.

steps.en: Texts are generic good practice. Every limit, interval and specification says per manufacturer manual. No machine specification is invented.
steps.id: Teks berupa praktik baik yang umum. Setiap batas, interval dan spesifikasi berbunyi sesuai manual pabrikan. Tidak ada spesifikasi mesin yang dikarang.

steps.en: Work instructions for weekly and monthly care start with lock-out tag-out and end with removing the lock and a test run.
steps.id: Instruksi perawatan mingguan dan bulanan diawali lock-out tag-out dan diakhiri melepas kunci dan uji jalan.

steps.en: The head of maintenance reviews each document, adds the limits from the manual, and sets the status to APPROVED. Until then the status stays DRAFT.
steps.id: Kepala maintenance meninjau tiap dokumen, menambah batas dari manual, dan mengubah status menjadi APPROVED. Sampai saat itu status tetap DRAFT.

steps.en: The Documents tab of the Asset Maintenance Profile shows the SOP and WI of that machine. Daily Check follows the daily WI, and Preventive Orders follow the weekly and monthly WI.
steps.id: Tab Documents pada Asset Maintenance Profile menampilkan SOP dan WI mesin itu. Daily Check mengikuti WI harian, dan Preventive Order mengikuti WI mingguan dan bulanan.

steps.en: Documents are stored in English. The Indonesian text for operators comes through the dictionary and the print language.
steps.id: Dokumen disimpan dalam bahasa Inggris. Teks Indonesia untuk operator datang lewat kamus dan bahasa cetak.

fields.label: Sets
fields.en: Twenty sets cover the forty-five machines: CTP, PLT, DIE, DIG, HTR, FGL, AGL, LAM, OFF, CUT, PRS, SEA, SHR, STI, STR, UVC, WBC, WAX, CMP, FKL.
fields.id: Dua puluh set mencakup empat puluh lima mesin: CTP, PLT, DIE, DIG, HTR, FGL, AGL, LAM, OFF, CUT, PRS, SEA, SHR, STI, STR, UVC, WBC, WAX, CMP, FKL.

fields.label: Documents per set
fields.en: One SOP and four WI, so one hundred documents in total.
fields.id: Satu SOP dan empat WI, jadi seratus dokumen seluruhnya.

fields.label: SOP sections
fields.en: Scope, Responsibilities, Safety, Procedure, Records, Review.
fields.id: Scope, Responsibilities, Safety, Procedure, Records, Review.

fields.label: Safety content
fields.en: General protective rules plus the hazards of that machine type, for example the cutting force of a die cutter or the pressure of a compressor.
fields.id: Aturan pelindung umum ditambah bahaya jenis mesin itu, misalnya gaya potong mesin die cut atau tekanan kompresor.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: DRAFT until approved by the head of maintenance, then APPROVED with a revision number.
fields.id: DRAFT sampai disetujui kepala maintenance, lalu APPROVED dengan nomor revisi.

fields.label: Source file
fields.en: The draft content is kept in resources/data/maintenance/sop_wi.json and seeded into the dummy database in Phase 1.
fields.id: Isi draf disimpan di resources/data/maintenance/sop_wi.json dan dimasukkan ke database dummy di Fase 1.

title: Technical Plan: Phase 1: Master Data

purpose.en: What Phase 1 delivers, how it is built step by step, and how it is tested.
purpose.id: Apa yang dikirim Fase 1, bagaimana dibangun langkah demi langkah, dan bagaimana diuji.

keywords: fase 1, master data, tm2mnt, migration, seeder, readiness, test, maintenance codes, profil aset

steps.en: Create the connection and databases first (done), then the Phase 1 tables in ddtmnt: mnt_code, mnt_asset, mnt_watch_point, mnt_asset_part, mnt_document, mnt_document_line, mnt_asset_document and mnt_log.
steps.id: Buat koneksi dan database lebih dulu (selesai), lalu tabel Fase 1 di ddtmnt: mnt_code, mnt_asset, mnt_watch_point, mnt_asset_part, mnt_document, mnt_document_line, mnt_asset_document dan mnt_log.

steps.en: The migration also creates module MAINT, the groups MAINT_TECH and MAINT_HEAD, the menu rows and the settings, and skips anything that already exists.
steps.id: Migration juga membuat modul MAINT, grup MAINT_TECH dan MAINT_HEAD, baris menu dan pengaturan, dan melewati yang sudah ada.

steps.en: Build Maintenance Codes first, then the Asset Maintenance Profile one tab at a time, then the Asset Readiness grid, then the menu and the Help topics.
steps.id: Bangun Maintenance Codes lebih dulu, lalu Asset Maintenance Profile satu tab per tab, lalu grid Asset Readiness, lalu menu dan topik Help.

steps.en: Example data goes only to ddtmnt through a seeder, without normal limits. Real machine data is never invented in tm2mnt.
steps.id: Data contoh hanya masuk ke ddtmnt lewat seeder, tanpa batas normal. Data mesin nyata tidak pernah dikarang di tm2mnt.

steps.en: Each step is committed separately so any step can be rolled back.
steps.id: Setiap langkah di-commit terpisah sehingga tiap langkah bisa di-rollback.

steps.en: Tests use the real local MySQL and clean up their own rows, then the database is checked directly instead of trusting the test script.
steps.id: Test memakai MySQL lokal sungguhan dan membersihkan barisnya sendiri, lalu database dicek langsung, bukan hanya percaya skrip test.

fields.label: Test: completeness
fields.en: Profile completeness is calculated correctly for several combinations of filled and empty items.
fields.id: Kelengkapan profil dihitung benar untuk beberapa kombinasi item terisi dan kosong.

fields.label: Test: copy
fields.en: Copy from machine does not overwrite rows that already exist on the target machine.
fields.id: Copy from machine tidak menimpa baris yang sudah ada pada mesin tujuan.

fields.label: Test: access
fields.en: A technician cannot save. The head of maintenance and administrators can.
fields.id: Teknisi tidak bisa menyimpan. Kepala maintenance dan administrator bisa.

fields.label: Test: spare part
fields.en: Only materials of the category Spare Part Machine can be chosen as machine parts.
fields.id: Hanya material kategori Spare Part Machine yang bisa dipilih sebagai part mesin.
