fields.label: Test: menu
fields.en: The menu shows only screens that exist.
fields.id: Menu hanya menampilkan layar yang ada.

fields.label: Deviation: PM Plans tab
fields.en: The PM Plans tab of the mockup is hidden until Phase 2, when plans exist.
fields.id: Tab PM Plans pada mockup disembunyikan sampai Fase 2, saat plan sudah ada.

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.en: Screens, migration, seeder, Help topics, build catalog entry, dictionary entries, tests.
fields.id: Layar, migration, seeder, topik Help, entri build catalog, entri kamus, test.

title: Technical Plan: Improvement, Daily Check and PM Calendar

purpose.en: Planned behaviour of three screens whose mockup is not approved yet: Improvement, Daily Check and PM Calendar. This is a proposal.
purpose.id: Perilaku yang direncanakan untuk tiga layar yang mockupnya belum disetujui: Improvement, Daily Check dan PM Calendar. Ini usulan.

keywords: improvement, daily check, pm calendar, kerusakan berulang, review sebelum sesudah, apply to master, evidence

steps.en: Daily Check is a sheet per machine per shift built from the active operator watch points. The operator marks each point OK, NOT_OK or NA and can type a measured value.
steps.id: Daily Check adalah lembar per mesin per shift yang dibuat dari watch point operator yang aktif. Operator menandai tiap titik OK, NOT_OK atau NA dan bisa mengetik nilai ukur.

steps.en: A NOT_OK point opens a Maintenance Request with a priority from the machine criticality. A measured value outside the normal limit is marked NOT_OK, and the operator can change it.
steps.id: Titik NOT_OK membuka Maintenance Request dengan prioritas dari kritikalitas mesin. Nilai ukur di luar batas normal ditandai NOT_OK, dan operator bisa mengubahnya.

steps.en: PM Calendar shows preventive and inspection maintenance orders by day: on schedule, inspection with fixed date, overdue, and machine blocked. A click opens the maintenance order.
steps.id: PM Calendar menampilkan order perawatan preventive dan inspeksi per hari: sesuai jadwal, inspeksi tanggal tetap, terlambat, dan mesin terblokir. Klik membuka order perawatan.

steps.en: Improvement starts from a request of kind IMPROVEMENT, from a repeated-failure suggestion, or from a person. The proposal states the problem, solution, estimated cost and saving.
steps.id: Improvement dimulai dari request jenis IMPROVEMENT, dari saran kerusakan berulang, atau dari seseorang. Usulan memuat masalah, solusi, estimasi biaya dan penghematan.

steps.en: Evidence (breakdowns, downtime, cost and linked maintenance orders for the same component) is calculated by the system and is read only.
steps.id: Evidence (jumlah breakdown, downtime, biaya dan order perawatan terkait untuk komponen yang sama) dihitung sistem dan hanya dibaca.

steps.en: The head of maintenance confirms the proposal. Above the cost limit set in Constants the director confirms too.
steps.id: Kepala maintenance mengonfirmasi usulan. Di atas batas biaya di Constants, direksi juga mengonfirmasi.

steps.en: An approved proposal creates a maintenance order of type IMPROVEMENT. When it is Done, the system schedules the review.
steps.id: Usulan yang disetujui membuat order perawatan jenis IMPROVEMENT. Saat Done, sistem menjadwalkan review.

steps.en: At review the system fills downtime and cost before and after over periods of equal length. A person concludes: Effective, Partial or Not effective.
steps.id: Saat review sistem mengisi downtime dan biaya sebelum dan sesudah pada periode sama panjang. Orang menyimpulkan: Effective, Partial atau Not effective.

steps.en: Apply to master opens the proposed changes (plan interval, watch point or machine part). The head ticks and approves each one. The system never changes the master itself.
steps.id: Apply to master membuka usulan perubahan (interval plan, watch point atau part mesin). Kepala mencentang dan menyetujui satu per satu. Sistem tidak pernah mengubah master sendiri.

fields.label: Repeated failure suggestion
fields.en: The same failure on the same component reaching the count in Constants within the window in Constants. The system suggests, it creates nothing.
fields.id: Kerusakan sama pada komponen yang sama mencapai jumlah di Constants dalam jendela di Constants. Sistem menyarankan, tidak membuat dokumen.

fields.label: Lifecycle
fields.en: Improvement uses the standard lifecycle: Draft, Confirmed, Cancelled, Closed.
fields.id: Improvement memakai lifecycle standar: Draft, Confirmed, Cancelled, Closed.

fields.label: Evidence
fields.en: Read only figures calculated from maintenance orders and downtime already recorded.
fields.id: Angka yang hanya dibaca, dihitung dari order perawatan dan downtime yang sudah tercatat.

fields.label: Review
fields.en: Due the number of days in Constants after Done. Before and after figures are filled by the system.
fields.id: Jatuh tempo sejumlah hari di Constants setelah Done. Angka sebelum dan sesudah diisi sistem.

fields.label: Apply to master
fields.en: Always a manual decision by a person, one change at a time, with a log entry for each.
fields.id: Selalu keputusan manual oleh orang, satu perubahan per satu, dengan catatan log untuk tiap perubahan.

title: Technical Plan: Phases 2 to 4 and Limits

purpose.en: What Phases 2, 3 and 4 deliver, in which order, and the limits that apply to all phases.
purpose.id: Apa yang dikirim Fase 2, 3 dan 4, dalam urutan apa, dan batas yang berlaku untuk semua fase.

keywords: fase 2, fase 3, fase 4, preventive, breakdown, improvement, urutan bangun, batas, zona beku, scheduling board

steps.en: Phase 2 Preventive (built): Preventive Plan, Preventive Maintenance Order, PM Calendar, Daily Check, Meter Readings, PM Compliance. Still to come in Phase 2: the machine-blocked slot on the Scheduling Board.
steps.id: Fase 2 Preventive (dibangun): Preventive Plan, Preventive Maintenance Order, PM Calendar, Daily Check, Meter Readings, PM Compliance. Yang masih menyusul di Fase 2: slot mesin terblokir di Scheduling Board.

steps.en: Phase 3 Breakdown: the Breakdown button on the production work list creates a request of priority P1, spare part issue to stock, purchase request with status Waiting Part, and the Machine Reliability report.
steps.id: Fase 3 Breakdown: tombol Breakdown di worklist produksi membuat request prioritas P1, pengeluaran spare part ke stok, permintaan pembelian dengan status Waiting Part, dan laporan Machine Reliability.

steps.en: Phase 4 Improvement: tables and service, repeated-failure detector, Proposal and Review screens, maintenance order type IMPROVEMENT, and Apply to master with manual approval.
steps.id: Fase 4 Improvement: tabel dan service, detektor kerusakan berulang, layar Proposal dan Review, order perawatan jenis IMPROVEMENT, dan Apply to master dengan persetujuan manual.

steps.en: Master Data comes first because the other phases read its data. Each phase is done when its tests pass and its data is checked in the database.
steps.id: Master Data lebih dulu karena fase lain membaca datanya. Tiap fase selesai bila test lulus dan datanya dicek di database.

steps.en: Work happens in the mockup site with ddt databases. Nothing is written to tm2 databases before release.
steps.id: Pekerjaan dilakukan di situs mockup dengan database ddt. Tidak ada yang ditulis ke database tm2 sebelum rilis.

steps.en: Inquiry, ProDev and ProCost are not touched. Screens are built from DevLib objects, without raw HTML.
steps.id: Inquiry, ProDev dan ProCost tidak disentuh. Layar dibangun dari objek DevLib, tanpa HTML mentah.

steps.en: Real machine data is never invented. Watch points, plan intervals and parts in the live database are filled by the head of maintenance through the screens.
steps.id: Data mesin nyata tidak pernah dikarang. Watch point, interval plan dan part di database live diisi kepala maintenance lewat layar.

fields.label: Planned percentage
fields.en: Planned maintenance orders divided by all maintenance orders. Shown in the reliability and compliance reports.
fields.id: Maintenance order terencana dibagi semua order perawatan. Tampil di laporan keandalan dan kepatuhan.

fields.label: Scheduling Board
fields.en: A confirmed preventive maintenance order blocks its machine. Production can only suggest moving the window, and the head of maintenance confirms.
fields.id: Maintenance order preventive Confirmed memblokir mesinnya. Produksi hanya bisa mengusulkan menggeser jendela, kepala maintenance yang mengonfirmasi.

fields.label: Inventory and Procurement
fields.en: Spare parts are issued from Inventory against the maintenance order. A missing part creates a purchase request.
fields.id: Spare part dikeluarkan dari Inventory terhadap order perawatan. Part yang kurang membuat permintaan pembelian.

fields.label: Backlog items still open
fields.en: Cleaning old spare parts that sit in the category Others, and the legal inspection rules for forklift and compressor.
fields.id: Perapian spare part lama yang masih di kategori Others, dan aturan inspeksi wajib untuk forklift dan kompresor.

title: Technical Plan: Why Maintenance Has Its Own Database

purpose.en: The reason Maintenance lives in tm2mnt instead of tm2prd, what it costs, and what is left to clean up in the live database.
purpose.id: Alasan Maintenance berada di tm2mnt dan bukan tm2prd, apa konsekuensinya, dan apa yang tersisa untuk dibersihkan di database live.

keywords: database maintenance, tm2mnt, ddtmnt, database per modul, tm2prd, pemisahan, rilis, migration

steps.en: The project rule is one database per functional module. Maintenance is now its own module (MAINT) with its own menu and access groups, like HRM, Recruitment and Payroll.
steps.id: Aturan proyek adalah satu database per modul fungsional. Maintenance kini modul sendiri (MAINT) dengan menu dan grup akses sendiri, seperti HRM, Recruitment dan Payroll.

steps.en: Production keeps maintenance orders, scheduling and output. Maintenance has its own life cycle of requests, maintenance orders, plans and improvements, so the two do not share tables.
steps.id: Production menyimpan order perawatan, scheduling dan output. Maintenance punya siklus sendiri berupa request, order perawatan, plan dan improvement, jadi keduanya tidak berbagi tabel.

steps.en: No foreign key crosses databases anyway, so separating them gives up no integrity. Relations stay logical and are checked in Laravel.
steps.id: Tidak ada foreign key lintas database, jadi pemisahan tidak mengorbankan integritas. Relasi tetap logis dan dicek di Laravel.

steps.en: Machine downtime and status stay in the Master database because Master Mesin owns them and scheduling and OEE read them. Maintenance orders write there through one service.
steps.id: Downtime dan status mesin tetap di database Master karena Master Mesin pemiliknya dan scheduling serta OEE membacanya. Maintenance order menulis ke sana lewat satu service.

steps.en: A separate server is not needed. Maintenance uses the same MySQL server with one more database.
steps.id: Server terpisah tidak diperlukan. Maintenance memakai server MySQL yang sama dengan satu database tambahan.

steps.en: At release a migration drops the old empty mnt_ tables in tm2prd and the old MAINT module, menu, groups and setting in tm2sys, then the new structure is created in tm2mnt.
steps.id: Saat rilis sebuah migration membuang tabel mnt_ lama yang kosong di tm2prd serta modul MAINT, menu, grup dan pengaturan lama di tm2sys, lalu struktur baru dibuat di tm2mnt.

fields.label: Connection
fields.en: tm2mnt, set by DB_MNT. In the mockup site it points to ddtmnt.
fields.id: tm2mnt, diatur oleh DB_MNT. Di situs mockup menunjuk ke ddtmnt.

fields.label: Copy to dummy
fields.en: ddt:copy with the option db=mnt copies tm2mnt to ddtmnt, including views.
fields.id: ddt:copy dengan opsi db=mnt menyalin tm2mnt ke ddtmnt, termasuk view.

fields.label: Left in tm2 today
fields.en: Eleven empty mnt_ tables in tm2prd (the code table has seed rows), module MAINT, its menu, two groups and one setting in tm2sys.
fields.id: Sebelas tabel mnt_ kosong di tm2prd (tabel kode berisi data awal), modul MAINT, menunya, dua grup dan satu pengaturan di tm2sys.

fields.label: Removed on 2026-10-08
fields.en: The previous Maintenance code, screens, tables and menu in the mockup databases were deleted without archive by user order.
fields.id: Kode, layar, tabel dan menu Maintenance sebelumnya di database mockup dihapus tanpa arsip atas perintah user.

title: Technical Plan: Decisions and Open Items

purpose.en: The decisions taken for the Maintenance rebuild, and the items still waiting for the user or for another team.
purpose.id: Keputusan yang diambil untuk pembangunan ulang Maintenance, dan hal yang masih menunggu user atau tim lain.

keywords: keputusan maintenance, item terbuka, K8, K10, ambang, constants, komponen tanpa pohon, apply to master

steps.en: Components are codes, not a tree. A machine list of 45 machines does not need machine, unit and component levels.
steps.id: Komponen berupa kode, bukan pohon. Daftar 45 mesin tidak butuh tingkat mesin, unit dan komponen.

steps.en: Request and Maintenance Order stay two documents. Daily Check and repeated failures enter through a Request so the head of maintenance does the judging.
steps.id: Request dan Maintenance Order tetap dua dokumen. Daily Check dan kerusakan berulang masuk lewat Request supaya penilaian ada di kepala maintenance.

steps.en: Thresholds and rates are settings in Constants so a user can change them without code. The values in this plan are starting proposals.
steps.id: Ambang dan tarif adalah pengaturan di Constants sehingga user bisa mengubahnya tanpa kode. Nilai di rencana ini adalah usulan awal.

steps.en: Master data is changed only by people. The system proposes, a person approves.
steps.id: Master data hanya diubah orang. Sistem mengusulkan, orang menyetujui.

steps.en: Stock is never copied into Maintenance. Screens read it from Inventory.
steps.id: Stok tidak pernah disalin ke Maintenance. Layar membacanya dari Inventory.

steps.en: Menu items move by migration with their codes unchanged, so access rights and Help stay attached.
steps.id: Item menu dipindah lewat migration dengan kodenya tidak berubah, sehingga hak akses dan Help tetap menempel.

steps.en: Two older open items do not block Phase 1: old spare parts in the category Others, and the legal inspection period of forklift and compressor.
steps.id: Dua item lama yang masih terbuka tidak menghambat Fase 1: spare part lama di kategori Others, dan periode inspeksi wajib forklift dan kompresor.

fields.label: Approved by user
fields.en: The four-group menu and the Asset Maintenance Profile mockup.
fields.id: Menu empat kelompok dan mockup Asset Maintenance Profile.

fields.label: Not approved yet
fields.en: The mockup of Improvement, Daily Check and PM Calendar, and the technical plan itself while it is under review.
fields.id: Mockup Improvement, Daily Check dan PM Calendar, dan rencana teknis itu sendiri selama masih di-review.

fields.label: Proposed values
fields.en: Three repeats, ninety days, review after sixty days, and director approval above ten million IDR. The user sets the final values.
fields.id: Tiga kali, sembilan puluh hari, review setelah enam puluh hari, dan persetujuan direksi di atas sepuluh juta IDR. User menetapkan nilai akhir.

fields.label: Waiting for others
fields.en: The legal inspection rules for forklift and compressor are to be checked with HR or K3.
fields.id: Aturan inspeksi wajib forklift dan kompresor perlu dicek ke HR atau K3.

title: Preventive Plan

purpose.en: Defines when an asset needs a scheduled job, which tasks and parts it needs, and creates a Preventive Maintenance Order when the job falls due. Open it to prepare or adjust a plan.
purpose.id: Menentukan kapan aset butuh pekerjaan terjadwal, tugas dan part yang dibutuhkan, dan membuat Preventive Maintenance Order saat pekerjaan jatuh tempo. Buka untuk menyiapkan atau mengubah plan.

keywords: preventive plan, plan perawatan, jadwal perawatan, jatuh tempo, pm, meter, interval, inspeksi, floating, fixed

steps.en: Open Preventive Plan. The boxes are Overdue, Due soon and Inspection. Search by plan code or asset.
steps.id: Buka Preventive Plan. Kotaknya Overdue, Due soon dan Inspection. Cari menurut kode plan atau aset.

steps.en: Click + New Record. Type the plan code and name, pick the asset and the order type (Preventive or Inspection), then Save.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Ketik kode dan nama plan, pilih aset dan jenis order (Preventive atau Inspection), lalu Save.

steps.en: On the Trigger tab choose Time, Meter or Time OR Meter and fill the interval from the manufacturer manual. Floating counts from the last completion, Fixed keeps calendar dates.
steps.id: Di tab Trigger pilih Time, Meter atau Time OR Meter dan isi interval dari manual pabrikan. Floating dihitung dari selesai terakhir, Fixed menjaga tanggal kalender.

steps.en: Add the checklist in the Tasks tab with + Task. Give a measure and limits only when the manual has them. Add standard parts in the Spare Parts tab.
steps.id: Tambah checklist di tab Tasks dengan + Task. Isi ukuran dan batas hanya bila ada di manual. Tambah part standar di tab Spare Parts.

steps.en: The next due date and meter are calculated by the system when you save. For a Fixed plan you type only the first date.
steps.id: Jatuh tempo berikutnya (tanggal dan meter) dihitung sistem saat Anda menyimpan. Untuk plan Fixed Anda hanya mengetik tanggal pertama.

steps.en: Every morning the system creates a Draft Preventive Maintenance Order for each plan that is due. Generate Order or Generate due orders does the same at once.
steps.id: Tiap pagi sistem membuat Preventive Maintenance Order Draft untuk setiap plan yang jatuh tempo. Generate Order atau Generate due orders melakukannya seketika.

steps.en: Only the head of maintenance and administrators can change a plan.
steps.id: Hanya kepala maintenance dan administrator yang bisa mengubah plan.

fields.label: Plan Code
fields.en: Short unique code of the plan.
fields.id: Kode singkat plan yang unik.

fields.label: Order Type
fields.en: Preventive for routine care, Inspection for legal or periodic inspections.
fields.id: Preventive untuk perawatan rutin, Inspection untuk inspeksi wajib atau berkala.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.en: Time, Meter, or Time OR Meter (whichever comes first).
fields.id: Time, Meter, atau Time OR Meter (mana yang lebih dulu).

fields.label: Every / Unit
fields.en: The time interval, for example 1 Month.
fields.id: Interval waktu, misalnya 1 Month.

fields.label: Meter / Or every (meter)
fields.en: The meter type and its interval, for example Odometer every 5,000 km.
fields.id: Jenis meter dan intervalnya, misalnya Odometer tiap 5.000 km.

fields.label: Schedule Mode
fields.en: Floating counts from the last completion. Fixed keeps calendar dates such as legal inspections.
fields.id: Floating dihitung dari selesai terakhir. Fixed menjaga tanggal kalender seperti inspeksi wajib.

fields.label: Create order before due (days)
fields.en: How many days before the due date the Draft order is created.
fields.id: Berapa hari sebelum jatuh tempo order Draft dibuat.

fields.label: Asset Stop
fields.en: Yes means the asset stops during the job. For a machine this records planned downtime.
fields.id: Yes berarti aset berhenti selama pekerjaan. Untuk mesin ini mencatat downtime terencana.

fields.label: Certificate valid until
fields.en: For inspections: the date the current certificate expires.
fields.id: Untuk inspeksi: tanggal sertifikat berjalan berakhir.

fields.label: Next due
fields.en: Calculated by the system. Only the first date of a Fixed plan is typed.
fields.id: Dihitung sistem. Hanya tanggal pertama plan Fixed yang diketik.

title: Preventive Maintenance Order

purpose.en: The scheduled job of an asset (PMO): who does it, when, which checklist, which parts, how long it took and what it cost. Open it daily to follow the planned work.
purpose.id: Pekerjaan terjadwal sebuah aset (PMO): siapa mengerjakan, kapan, checklist, part, berapa lama dan biayanya. Buka tiap hari untuk memantau pekerjaan terencana.

keywords: pmo, preventive maintenance order, order perawatan, perawatan terjadwal, inspeksi, checklist, downtime terencana

steps.en: Open Preventive Maintenance Order. The boxes are All Open, In Progress, Waiting Part, Overdue and Done.
steps.id: Buka Preventive Maintenance Order. Kotaknya All Open, In Progress, Waiting Part, Overdue dan Done.

steps.en: Orders mostly arrive as Draft from a Preventive Plan. For a one-off job click + New Record and type the asset, type and description.
steps.id: Order sebagian besar datang sebagai Draft dari Preventive Plan. Untuk pekerjaan sekali jalan klik + New Record dan ketik aset, jenis dan deskripsi.

steps.en: Open a Draft order, set the planned start, the technician and the priority, then press Confirm. The number PMO-yymm-nnnn is created and the status is Scheduled.
steps.id: Buka order Draft, atur rencana mulai, teknisi dan prioritas, lalu tekan Confirm. Nomor PMO-yymm-nnnn dibuat dan status menjadi Scheduled.

steps.en: The technician presses Start. For a machine that must stop, the system opens a planned downtime and sets the machine status to Maintenance.
steps.id: Teknisi menekan Start. Untuk mesin yang harus berhenti, sistem membuka downtime terencana dan mengubah status mesin menjadi Maintenance.

steps.en: Fill the checklist results, add parts and technician hours. Press Hold when waiting for a part and Resume when it arrives.
steps.id: Isi hasil checklist, tambah part dan jam teknisi. Tekan Hold saat menunggu part dan Resume saat part tiba.

steps.en: Press Done when finished. Every required checklist task needs a result first. Downtime is closed and the machine is Ready again.
steps.id: Tekan Done bila selesai. Setiap tugas checklist wajib harus punya hasil lebih dulu. Downtime ditutup dan mesin kembali Ready.

steps.en: The head of maintenance presses Close. Cost becomes final and the plan moves to its next due date.
steps.id: Kepala maintenance menekan Close. Biaya menjadi final dan plan maju ke jatuh tempo berikutnya.

steps.en: Cancel needs a reason. Back to Draft is possible only while the order is Scheduled and has not started.
steps.id: Cancel butuh alasan. Back to Draft hanya bisa saat order masih Scheduled dan belum dimulai.

fields.label: Asset
fields.en: The asset the work is for. Picked from the asset list.
fields.id: Aset yang dikerjakan. Dipilih dari daftar aset.

fields.label: Order Type
fields.en: Preventive or Inspection for this screen.
fields.id: Preventive atau Inspection untuk layar ini.

fields.label: Priority
fields.en: P1 Emergency, P2 High, P3 Normal or P4 Low.
fields.id: P1 Emergency, P2 High, P3 Normal atau P4 Low.

fields.label: Technician
fields.en: The employee who does the work.
fields.id: Pegawai yang mengerjakan.

fields.label: Asset Stop
fields.en: Yes records downtime for a machine and changes its status while the work runs.
fields.id: Yes mencatat downtime untuk mesin dan mengubah statusnya selama pekerjaan berjalan.

fields.label: Planned Start / End
fields.en: The scheduled window. The calendar and the compliance report use the start date as the due date.
fields.id: Jendela jadwal. Kalender dan laporan kepatuhan memakai tanggal mulai sebagai jatuh tempo.

fields.label: Checklist
fields.en: Tasks copied from the plan. Each gets a result OK, Not OK or N/A and an optional measured value.
fields.id: Tugas yang disalin dari plan. Tiap tugas diberi hasil OK, Not OK atau N/A dan nilai ukur opsional.

fields.label: Spare Parts
fields.en: Parts planned and used. The cost uses the average price at the time the part was added.
fields.id: Part yang direncanakan dan dipakai. Biaya memakai harga rata-rata saat part ditambahkan.

fields.label: Labor
fields.en: Technician minutes. The cost uses the hourly rate set in Settings, Constants.
fields.id: Menit teknisi. Biaya memakai tarif per jam yang diatur di Settings, Constants.

fields.label: Meter at Done
fields.en: Counter reading when the work finished, used to calculate the next meter-based due.
fields.id: Pembacaan counter saat pekerjaan selesai, dipakai menghitung jatuh tempo berikutnya berbasis meter.

title: PM Calendar

purpose.en: Shows the scheduled Preventive Maintenance Orders on a month calendar, so the head of maintenance sees the load of the month at a glance. Open it to plan or to avoid clashes.
purpose.id: Menampilkan Preventive Maintenance Order terjadwal di kalender bulanan, supaya kepala maintenance melihat beban satu bulan sekaligus. Buka untuk merencanakan atau menghindari bentrok.

keywords: pm calendar, kalender perawatan, jadwal pmo, kalender preventive, bulan

steps.en: Open PM Calendar. The month view shows each order with its number and asset.
steps.id: Buka PM Calendar. Tampilan bulan menunjukkan tiap order dengan nomor dan asetnya.

steps.en: Use the arrows or Today to move between months. Draft orders show without a number.
steps.id: Pakai panah atau Today untuk berpindah bulan. Order Draft tampil tanpa nomor.

steps.en: The list under the calendar shows the next open orders in date order.
steps.id: Daftar di bawah kalender menampilkan order terbuka berikutnya menurut tanggal.

steps.en: To change a schedule open the order in Preventive Maintenance Order and edit its planned dates there.
steps.id: Untuk mengubah jadwal buka order di Preventive Maintenance Order dan ubah tanggal rencananya di sana.

fields.label: Order
fields.en: Order number, or Draft when it is not confirmed yet.
fields.id: Nomor order, atau Draft bila belum dikonfirmasi.

fields.label: Asset
fields.en: Code and name of the asset.
fields.id: Kode dan nama aset.

fields.label: Planned
fields.en: Planned start date and time.
fields.id: Tanggal dan jam rencana mulai.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Draft, Scheduled, In Progress, Waiting Part or Done.
fields.id: Draft, Scheduled, In Progress, Waiting Part atau Done.

title: Daily Check

purpose.en: The operator check of an asset each shift, built from its operator watch points. Anything Not OK becomes a Maintenance Request before it turns into a breakdown. Open it at the start of the shift.
purpose.id: Cek operator atas sebuah aset tiap shift, dibuat dari watch point operatornya. Hal yang Not OK menjadi Maintenance Request sebelum berubah menjadi kerusakan. Buka di awal shift.

keywords: daily check, cek harian, operator, shift, watch point, not ok, tpm, request

steps.en: Open Daily Check and click + New Record. Pick the asset, the date and the shift, then Open Sheet.
steps.id: Buka Daily Check dan klik + New Record. Pilih aset, tanggal dan shift, lalu Open Sheet.

steps.en: The sheet lists the active operator watch points that are Every shift or Daily. If the asset has none, add them in Asset Maintenance Profile first.
steps.id: Lembar berisi watch point operator aktif yang frekuensinya Every shift atau Daily. Bila aset tidak punya, tambahkan dulu di Asset Maintenance Profile.

steps.en: Mark each point OK, Not OK or N/A. Type the measured value when the point has limits. A value outside the limits is suggested as Not OK.
steps.id: Tandai tiap titik OK, Not OK atau N/A. Ketik nilai ukur bila titik punya batas. Nilai di luar batas disarankan sebagai Not OK.

steps.en: Add a note for anything abnormal and click Save to keep the sheet while you work.
steps.id: Tambah catatan untuk hal tidak normal dan klik Save untuk menyimpan lembar selama bekerja.

steps.en: Click Submit when every point has a result. The sheet is locked and each Not OK point opens a Maintenance Request for the head of maintenance.
steps.id: Klik Submit bila semua titik punya hasil. Lembar terkunci dan tiap titik Not OK membuka Maintenance Request untuk kepala maintenance.

steps.en: Opening the same asset, date and shift again shows the same sheet, never a second one.
steps.id: Membuka aset, tanggal dan shift yang sama lagi menampilkan lembar yang sama, bukan lembar kedua.

fields.label: Sheet
fields.en: Number DC-yymm-nnnn.
fields.id: Nomor DC-yymm-nnnn.

fields.label: What to check
fields.en: Copied from the watch point so history stays correct if the watch point changes.
fields.id: Disalin dari watch point sehingga riwayat tetap benar bila watch point berubah.

fields.label: Normal limit
fields.en: Minimum and maximum from the watch point. Empty means the system never judges the value.
fields.id: Minimum dan maksimum dari watch point. Kosong berarti sistem tidak pernah menilai nilainya.

fields.label: Result
fields.en: OK, Not OK or N/A.
fields.id: OK, Not OK atau N/A.

fields.label: Measured
fields.en: The value you read, for points with a measure.
fields.id: Nilai yang Anda baca, untuk titik yang punya ukuran.

fields.label: Request
fields.en: Shows Request opened for a Not OK point after Submit.
fields.id: Menampilkan Request opened untuk titik Not OK setelah Submit.

title: Meter Readings

purpose.en: Records the counter of an asset (run hours, impressions, odometer) so meter-based plans fall due at the right time. Open it to type a reading or to correct a counter.
purpose.id: Mencatat counter aset (jam jalan, impresi, odometer) supaya plan berbasis meter jatuh tempo pada waktu yang tepat. Buka untuk mengetik pembacaan atau mengoreksi counter.

keywords: meter, odometer, jam jalan, impresi, counter, pembacaan meter

steps.en: Open Meter Readings. Rows are typed directly in the cells.
steps.id: Buka Meter Readings. Barisnya diketik langsung di sel.

steps.en: Add a row: pick the asset, the meter, the date and the reading, then Save.
steps.id: Tambah baris: pilih aset, meter, tanggal dan pembacaan, lalu Save.

steps.en: Production machines with a run-hours or impressions meter are also updated every morning from production output, starting from your first typed reading.
steps.id: Mesin produksi dengan meter jam jalan atau impresi juga diperbarui tiap pagi dari output produksi, mulai dari pembacaan pertama yang Anda ketik.

steps.en: A reading lower than the last one needs a note, for example the counter was replaced.
steps.id: Pembacaan yang lebih rendah dari yang terakhir butuh catatan, misalnya counter diganti.

steps.en: An old reading is never changed. To correct it add a new row.
steps.id: Pembacaan lama tidak pernah diubah. Untuk mengoreksi tambahkan baris baru.

fields.label: Asset
fields.en: The asset the counter belongs to.
fields.id: Aset pemilik counter.

fields.label: Meter
fields.en: Run hours, Impressions or Odometer (km).
fields.id: Run hours, Impressions atau Odometer (km).

fields.label: Date
fields.en: When the counter was read.
fields.id: Kapan counter dibaca.

fields.label: Reading
fields.en: The counter value, not the difference.
fields.id: Nilai counter, bukan selisihnya.

fields.label: Source
fields.en: Typed by user or Production output. Filled by the system.
fields.id: Typed by user atau Production output. Diisi sistem.

fields.label: Note
fields.en: Required when the reading is lower than the last one.
fields.id: Wajib bila pembacaan lebih rendah dari yang terakhir.

title: PM Compliance

purpose.en: Shows whether the scheduled Preventive Maintenance Orders were done on time. Open it to find the assets or months where preventive work slips.
purpose.id: Menunjukkan apakah Preventive Maintenance Order terjadwal selesai tepat waktu. Buka untuk menemukan aset atau bulan tempat pekerjaan preventive tertunda.

keywords: pm compliance, kepatuhan pm, tepat waktu, terlambat, preventive, laporan

steps.en: Open PM Compliance. The boxes are All, On time, Late and Not done.
steps.id: Buka PM Compliance. Kotaknya All, On time, Late dan Not done.

steps.en: Group by Month or Asset. The three count columns give subtotals per group.
steps.id: Kelompokkan menurut Month atau Asset. Tiga kolom hitung memberi subtotal per kelompok.

steps.en: Compliance percent is On time divided by On time plus Late plus Not done.
steps.id: Persen kepatuhan adalah On time dibagi On time ditambah Late ditambah Not done.

steps.en: An order that is not yet past its due date plus tolerance and not done is Not yet due and is not counted.
steps.id: Order yang belum lewat jatuh tempo ditambah toleransi dan belum selesai berstatus Not yet due dan tidak dihitung.

steps.en: Click a row to open the order.
steps.id: Klik sebuah baris untuk membuka order.

fields.label: Order
fields.en: The Preventive Maintenance Order number.
fields.id: Nomor Preventive Maintenance Order.

fields.label: Due
fields.en: The planned start date of the order.
fields.id: Tanggal rencana mulai order.

fields.label: Done On
fields.en: The date the work finished.
fields.id: Tanggal pekerjaan selesai.

fields.label: Result
fields.en: On time, Late, Not done or Not yet due.
fields.id: On time, Late, Not done atau Not yet due.

fields.label: On time tolerance
fields.en: Set in Settings, Constants as a percent of the plan interval, at least one day.
fields.id: Diatur di Settings, Constants sebagai persen dari interval plan, minimal satu hari.

title: Maintenance Request

purpose.en: Anyone reports a problem here: a breakdown, something to fix, or a safety risk. The head of maintenance decides what becomes a Breakdown Maintenance Order. Open it when something is wrong with an asset.
purpose.id: Siapa pun melapor masalah di sini: kerusakan, sesuatu yang perlu diperbaiki, atau risiko keselamatan. Kepala maintenance memutuskan apa yang menjadi Breakdown Maintenance Order. Buka bila ada yang tidak beres pada aset.

keywords: request, maintenance request, laporan kerusakan, breakdown, lapor mesin, p1, darurat, accept, reject, keselamatan

steps.en: Click + New Record. Pick the asset and the kind: Breakdown, Corrective or Safety.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Pilih aset dan jenisnya: Breakdown, Corrective atau Safety.

steps.en: Tick The asset is stopped when it cannot run, and describe what is wrong in the symptom.
steps.id: Centang The asset is stopped bila aset tidak bisa jalan, dan jelaskan masalahnya di symptom.

steps.en: Leave Priority on Auto. Safety, or a stopped machine of criticality A or B, is P1. Click Send Request.
steps.id: Biarkan Priority di Auto. Keselamatan, atau mesin berhenti dengan kritikalitas A atau B, adalah P1. Klik Send Request.

steps.en: A P1 request does not wait: a Breakdown Maintenance Order is created and confirmed at once and appears in My Work.
steps.id: Request P1 tidak menunggu: Breakdown Maintenance Order langsung dibuat dan dikonfirmasi dan muncul di My Work.

steps.en: For other requests the head of maintenance opens the request and clicks Accept (a Draft order is made) or Reject (a reason is required).
steps.id: Untuk request lain kepala maintenance membuka request dan klik Accept (Draft order dibuat) atau Reject (alasan wajib).

steps.en: A breakdown reported on the shop floor in Work Order entry creates a request by itself. A failed Daily Check point does too.
steps.id: Kerusakan yang dilaporkan di lantai produksi pada Work Order entry membuat request sendiri. Titik Daily Check yang gagal juga.

fields.label: Priority
fields.en: P1 emergency, P2 high, P3 normal, P4 low. Auto suggests it from the kind, the stop and the criticality.
fields.id: P1 darurat, P2 tinggi, P3 normal, P4 rendah. Auto mengusulkannya dari jenis, kondisi berhenti dan kritikalitas.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Open waits for a decision, Accepted has an order, Rejected has a reason.
fields.id: Open menunggu keputusan, Accepted punya order, Rejected punya alasan.

fields.label: Source
fields.en: Manual, or Daily Check when an operator marked a point Not OK.
fields.id: Manual, atau Daily Check bila operator menandai titik Not OK.

title: Breakdown Maintenance Order

purpose.en: The repair job for a breakdown or a corrective fix. It records the work, the spare parts and the hours, and keeps the machine status and downtime true. Open it from a request or from My Work.
purpose.id: Pekerjaan perbaikan untuk kerusakan atau perbaikan korektif. Mencatat pekerjaan, spare part dan jam kerja, dan menjaga status mesin dan downtime tetap benar. Buka dari request atau dari My Work.

keywords: bmo, breakdown maintenance order, perbaikan, repair, spare part, issue parts, create pr, downtime, waiting part

steps.en: A BMO is made from an accepted request, or by + New Record for a one-off job. The head of maintenance confirms it and the number BMO-yymm-nnnn is born.
steps.id: BMO dibuat dari request yang diterima, atau + New Record untuk pekerjaan sekali. Kepala maintenance mengonfirmasinya dan nomor BMO-yymm-nnnn lahir.

steps.en: The technician clicks Start. For a machine the downtime opens and the machine status changes to Breakdown.
steps.id: Teknisi klik Start. Untuk mesin, downtime terbuka dan status mesin berubah menjadi Breakdown.

steps.en: Fill the Failure tab: problem, cause and action codes, and the findings. Add spare parts and labor hours.
steps.id: Isi tab Failure: kode masalah, penyebab dan tindakan, serta temuan. Tambahkan spare part dan jam kerja.

steps.en: The Spare Parts tab shows the stock on hand. Click Issue Parts to take the parts from the warehouse; the stock card follows.
steps.id: Tab Spare Parts menunjukkan stok yang ada. Klik Issue Parts untuk mengambil part dari gudang; kartu stok ikut.

steps.en: A part that stock cannot cover stays on the order. Click Create PR to draft a purchase requisition, then Hold the order while waiting for the part.
steps.id: Part yang tidak tercukupi stok tetap di order. Klik Create PR untuk membuat draft purchase requisition, lalu Hold order selagi menunggu part.

steps.en: Click Done when the checklist is complete: the downtime closes and the machine is Ready again. The head of maintenance clicks Close to fix the cost.
steps.id: Klik Done bila checklist lengkap: downtime menutup dan mesin Ready lagi. Kepala maintenance klik Close untuk mengunci biaya.

fields.label: In Stock
fields.en: Usable stock of the part in all warehouses now.
fields.id: Stok part yang bisa dipakai di semua gudang sekarang.

fields.label: Issued
fields.en: What was already taken from the warehouse for this order.
fields.id: Yang sudah diambil dari gudang untuk order ini.

fields.label: PR
fields.en: The purchase requisition drafted for this part.
fields.id: Purchase requisition yang dibuat untuk part ini.

title: My Work

purpose.en: The list of orders a technician has to do: those assigned to you and those nobody has taken yet. Open it at the start of the shift.
purpose.id: Daftar order yang harus dikerjakan teknisi: yang ditugaskan kepada Anda dan yang belum diambil siapa pun. Buka di awal shift.

keywords: my work, pekerjaan saya, teknisi, daftar kerja, order saya, unassigned

steps.en: Open My Work. The boxes are All, Mine, Unassigned, In Progress and Waiting Part.
steps.id: Buka My Work. Kotaknya All, Mine, Unassigned, In Progress dan Waiting Part.

steps.en: The most urgent orders come first: by priority, then by planned start.
steps.id: Order paling mendesak ada di atas: menurut prioritas, lalu rencana mulai.

steps.en: Click a row to open the order, then Start, record the work and click Done.
steps.id: Klik sebuah baris untuk membuka order, lalu Start, catat pekerjaan dan klik Done.

steps.en: Unassigned orders are assigned by the head of maintenance in the order itself.
steps.id: Order Unassigned ditugaskan kepala maintenance di dalam order itu sendiri.

title: Maintenance Dashboard

purpose.en: Shows how the machines and the maintenance team are doing against their targets, and what needs action today. Open it first when you enter the Maintenance module.
purpose.id: Menunjukkan kondisi mesin dan tim maintenance terhadap target, dan apa yang perlu ditindak hari ini. Buka pertama kali saat masuk modul Maintenance.

keywords: dashboard, kpi, availability, mtbf, mttr, oee, pm compliance, planned work, backlog, target, biaya

steps.en: Pick the period and, if you like, one machine, then click Show.
steps.id: Pilih periode dan, bila perlu, satu mesin, lalu klik Show.

steps.en: Indicators: availability, MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance, planned work and backlog. The lamp turns green, yellow or red against the target.
steps.id: Indikator: availability, MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance, planned work dan backlog. Lampu hijau, kuning atau merah terhadap target.

steps.en: Needs action today are counts without a target: machines down, open requests, overdue preventive orders, orders in progress, orders waiting for parts and critical parts below minimum.
steps.id: Perlu tindakan hari ini adalah angka tanpa target: mesin berhenti, request terbuka, preventive terlambat, order berjalan, order menunggu part dan part kritis di bawah minimum.

steps.en: The charts show the PM compliance trend, the machines with the most downtime and the failures by component.
steps.id: Grafik menunjukkan tren kepatuhan PM, mesin dengan downtime terbanyak dan kerusakan per komponen.

steps.en: OEE is only displayed: Production calculates it and Maintenance contributes the downtime. If a factor is missing, OEE is not calculated, never 0.
steps.id: OEE hanya ditampilkan: Production menghitungnya dan Maintenance menyumbang downtime. Bila ada faktor yang kosong, OEE tidak dihitung, bukan 0.

steps.en: The targets are set by the head of maintenance in Settings, Constants, group MAINTENANCE (MNT_TARGET_).
steps.id: Target diatur kepala maintenance di Settings, Constants, grup MAINTENANCE (MNT_TARGET_).

fields.label: MTBF
fields.en: Mean time between failures: period hours of all machines minus repair hours, divided by the number of breakdowns.
fields.id: Rata-rata waktu antar kerusakan: jam periode semua mesin dikurangi jam perbaikan, dibagi jumlah kerusakan.

fields.label: MTTR
fields.en: Mean time to repair: repair hours divided by the number of breakdowns.
fields.id: Rata-rata waktu perbaikan: jam perbaikan dibagi jumlah kerusakan.

fields.label: Backlog
fields.en: Estimated hours of open orders divided by the technician hours available per week.
fields.id: Perkiraan jam order terbuka dibagi jam teknisi yang tersedia per minggu.

fields.label: Planned work
fields.en: Orders that are not Breakdown divided by all orders in the period.
fields.id: Order yang bukan Breakdown dibagi semua order pada periode.

title: Machine Reliability

purpose.en: One row per machine: how often it breaks, how long repairs take, how much it was down and what maintenance cost. Use it to decide which machine needs a better plan, an improvement or a replacement.
purpose.id: Satu baris per mesin: seberapa sering rusak, berapa lama perbaikan, berapa lama berhenti dan berapa biaya maintenance. Gunakan untuk memutuskan mesin mana yang perlu plan lebih baik, perbaikan atau penggantian.

keywords: machine reliability, keandalan mesin, mtbf, mttr, downtime, oee, biaya maintenance, laporan

steps.en: Pick the period and click Show. The default is the last 90 days.
steps.id: Pilih periode dan klik Show. Bawaannya 90 hari terakhir.

steps.en: Breakdowns, MTTR and MTBF come from the downtime log of finished breakdown orders. A dash means it cannot be calculated yet.
steps.id: Breakdowns, MTTR dan MTBF berasal dari log downtime order kerusakan yang selesai. Tanda strip berarti belum bisa dihitung.

steps.en: Availability and OEE come from Production and stay blank while the machine calendar or output is missing.
steps.id: Availability dan OEE berasal dari Production dan kosong selama kalender mesin atau output belum ada.

steps.en: Inherent availability is MTBF divided by MTBF plus MTTR. It is not the same as the availability inside OEE.
steps.id: Inherent availability adalah MTBF dibagi MTBF ditambah MTTR. Tidak sama dengan availability di dalam OEE.

title: Maintenance Order Report

purpose.en: One row per confirmed Maintenance Order with hours and cost. Group it to see where the time and money go: by month, asset, type or technician.
purpose.id: Satu baris per Maintenance Order yang sudah dikonfirmasi dengan jam dan biaya. Kelompokkan untuk melihat ke mana waktu dan uang pergi: menurut bulan, aset, jenis atau teknisi.

keywords: maintenance order report, laporan order, biaya, jam kerja, teknisi, pmo, bmo, laporan

steps.en: Open the report and use the boxes All, Breakdown and Preventive, or the Filter button.
steps.id: Buka laporan dan pakai kotak All, Breakdown dan Preventive, atau tombol Filter.

steps.en: Group by Month, Asset, Type, Technician or Status. Hours and the cost columns give subtotals.
steps.id: Kelompokkan menurut Month, Asset, Type, Technician atau Status. Jam dan kolom biaya memberi subtotal.

steps.en: Hours are the actual start to the actual end. Cost is spare parts plus labor at the standard rate plus vendor service.
steps.id: Jam adalah mulai aktual sampai selesai aktual. Biaya adalah spare part ditambah tenaga pada tarif standar ditambah jasa vendor.

steps.en: Click a row to open the order.
steps.id: Klik sebuah baris untuk membuka order.

title: Breakdown Flow, Spare Parts and the Scheduling Hold

purpose.en: Explains what happens, step by step and in which data, from a machine breakdown to a closed order: the request, the order, the spare parts, the purchase requisition and the hold on the Scheduling Board.
purpose.id: Menjelaskan apa yang terjadi, langkah demi langkah dan di data mana, dari mesin rusak sampai order ditutup: request, order, spare part, purchase requisition dan penahanan mesin di Scheduling Board.

keywords: breakdown flow, alur kerusakan, data flow, spare part, stock out, purchase requisition, scheduling, mtn, p1, downtime

steps.en: Work flow: report (Work Order entry, Daily Check or Maintenance Request), then the request, then the Breakdown Maintenance Order, then Start, Done and Close.
steps.id: Alur kerja: laporan (Work Order entry, Daily Check atau Maintenance Request), lalu request, lalu Breakdown Maintenance Order, lalu Start, Done dan Close.

steps.en: A shop floor breakdown report in Work Order entry also creates a request, linked to the production breakdown event. The production report is never blocked.
steps.id: Laporan kerusakan di Work Order entry juga membuat request, terhubung ke kejadian kerusakan produksi. Laporan produksi tidak pernah terhalang.

steps.en: Data flow of the downtime: Start opens one row in the machine downtime log, Done closes it. OEE, MTBF and MTTR read that same log, so they use the repair time you recorded.
steps.id: Alur data downtime: Start membuka satu baris di log downtime mesin, Done menutupnya. OEE, MTBF dan MTTR membaca log yang sama, jadi memakai waktu perbaikan yang Anda catat.

steps.en: Data flow of the spare parts: Issue Parts makes a normal Stock Out in Inventory and posts it, so the stock card and the stock value follow. Maintenance never writes the stock tables itself.
steps.id: Alur data spare part: Issue Parts membuat Stock Out biasa di Inventory dan memostingnya, jadi kartu stok dan nilai stok ikut. Maintenance tidak pernah menulis tabel stok sendiri.

steps.en: A part that stock cannot cover is not issued. Create PR drafts a purchase requisition for the shortage; submit it in Procurement.
steps.id: Part yang tidak tercukupi stok tidak dikeluarkan. Create PR membuat draft purchase requisition untuk kekurangannya; ajukan di Procurement.

steps.en: A confirmed order that stops a machine holds that machine in Scheduling: backward scheduling skips those hours, a manual move into them is refused and the board shows them as MTN.
steps.id: Order terkonfirmasi yang menghentikan mesin menahan mesin itu di Scheduling: penjadwalan mundur melewati jam itu, geser manual ke dalamnya ditolak dan board menampilkannya sebagai MTN.

steps.en: Cost flow: spare parts at the item average cost, labor at the standard hourly rate (a constant, not payroll data) and vendor service. The cost is final at Close.
steps.id: Alur biaya: spare part pada biaya rata-rata item, tenaga pada tarif standar per jam (konstanta, bukan data gaji) dan jasa vendor. Biaya final saat Close.
